children.translated_text: If it were otherwise there would be fault; therefore favor is not remembered otherwise.

children.text: snehād vā yadi vā lobhād bhayād ajñānato 'pi vā ||
children.translated_text: Whether from affection, or from greed, fear, or even ignorance,

children.text: kurvanty anugrahaṃ ye tu tat pāpaṃ teṣu gacchati
children.translated_text: those who grant favor improperly have that sin pass to them.

children.text: śarīrasyātyaye prāpte vadanti niyamaṃ tu ye ||
children.translated_text: Those who state a rule when danger to the body has arrived

children.text: mahat kāryoparodhena na svasthasya kadācana
children.translated_text: do so because of obstruction to a great matter, never for a healthy person.

children.text: svasthasya mūḍhāḥ kurvanti vadanty aniyamaṃ tu ye ||
children.translated_text: Fools who do this for a healthy person, and who declare absence of rule,

children.text: te tasya vighnakartāraḥ patanti narake 'śucau
children.translated_text: are obstructors of his rite and fall into an impure hell.

children.text: svayam eva vrataṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇaṃ yo 'vamanyate ||
children.translated_text: A man who, after undertaking a vow himself, despises a brahmin,

children.text: vṛthā tasyopavāsaḥ syān na sa puṇyena yujyate
children.translated_text: has his fast in vain; he is not joined with merit.

children.text: sa eva niyamo grāhyo yady eko 'pi vaded dvijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That very rule is to be accepted if even a single twice-born man states it.

children.text: kuryād vākyaṃ dvijānāṃ tu anyathā bhrūṇahā bhavet
children.translated_text: One should carry out the word of the twice-born; otherwise one becomes a killer of an embryo.

children.text: brāhmaṇā jaṅgamaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthabhūtā hi sādhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Brahmins are a moving tīrtha; the good are indeed themselves tīrthas.

children.text: teṣāṃ vākyodakenaiva śudhyanti malinā janāḥ
children.translated_text: Impure people are purified by the water of their words alone.

children.text: brāhmaṇā yāni bhāṣante manyante tāni devatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever brahmins utter, the deities consider that to be so.

children.text: sarvadevamayo vipro na tadvacanam anyathā
children.translated_text: A brahmin contains all the gods; his word is not otherwise.

children.text: upavāso vrataṃ caiva snānaṃ tīrthaṃ japas tapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Fasting, a vow, bathing, a tīrtha, recitation, and austerity:

children.text: viprasampāditaṃ yasya sampūrṇaṃ tasya tat phalam
children.translated_text: for one for whom it has been completed by a brahmin, its fruit is complete.

children.text: annādye kīṭasaṃyukte makṣikākeśadūṣite ||
children.translated_text: When food and eatables are joined with insects, or polluted by flies and hair,

children.text: tadantarā spṛśec cāpas tad annaṃ bhasmanā spṛśet
children.translated_text: one should touch water in between, and touch that food with ashes.

children.text: bhuñjānaś caiva yo vipraḥ pādaṃ hastena saṃspṛśet ||
children.translated_text: And if a brahmin, while eating, touches his foot with his hand,

children.text: svam ucchiṣṭam asau bhuṅkte pāṇinā muktabhājane
children.translated_text: he eats his own leftovers with the hand in the vessel that has been released.

children.text: pādukāstho na bhuñjīta paryaṅke saṃsthito 'pi vā ||
children.translated_text: One should not eat while wearing sandals, nor while seated on a couch.

children.text: śvānacaṇḍāladṛṣṭau ca bhojanaṃ parivarjayet
children.translated_text: And when seen by dogs or caṇḍālas, one should avoid the meal.

children.text: yad annaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ syād annaśuddhis tathaiva ca ||
children.translated_text: What food is prohibited, and likewise the purification of food,

children.text: yathā parāśareṇoktaṃ tathaivāhaṃ vadāmi vaḥ
children.translated_text: just as it was spoken by <s>Parāśara</s>, so I tell you.

children.text: śṛtaṃ droṇāḍhakasyānnaṃ kākaśvānopaghātitam ||
children.translated_text: Cooked food amounting to a droṇa or an āḍhaka, struck by crows or dogs:

children.text: kenedaṃ śudhyate ceti brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet
children.translated_text: one should report to the brahmins, 'By what is this purified?'

children.text: kākaśvānāvalīḍhaṃ tu droṇānnaṃ na parityajet ||
children.translated_text: One should not discard a droṇa of food licked by crows or dogs,

children.text: vedavedāṅgavidviprair dharmaśāstrānupālakaiḥ
children.translated_text: when there are brahmins learned in the Veda and Vedāṅgas and following dharmaśāstra.

children.text: prasthā dvātriṃśatir droṇaḥ smṛto dviprastha āḍhakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thirty-two prasthas are remembered as a droṇa; an āḍhaka is two prasthas.

children.text: tato droṇāḍhakasyānnaṃ śrutismṛtivido viduḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore those who know śruti and smṛti know the food of a droṇa or an āḍhaka.

children.text: kākaśvānāvalīḍhaṃ tu gavāghrātaṃ khareṇa vā ||
children.translated_text: Food licked by crows or dogs, or smelled by a cow or by a donkey:

children.text: svalpam annaṃ tyajed vipraḥ śuddhir droṇāḍhake bhavet
children.translated_text: a brahmin should discard a small amount of food; for a droṇa or āḍhaka there is purification.

children.text: annasyoddhṛtya tanmātraṃ yacca lālāhataṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: Having removed from the food just as much as has been struck by saliva,

children.text: suvarṇodakam abhyukṣya hutāśenaiva tāpayet
children.translated_text: one should sprinkle it with gold-water and heat it with fire.

children.text: hutāśanena saṃspṛṣṭaṃ suvarṇasalilena ca ||
children.translated_text: Touched by fire and by gold-water,

children.text: viprāṇāṃ brahmaghoṣeṇa bhojyaṃ bhavati tatkṣaṇāt
children.translated_text: through the brahma-sound of brahmins, it becomes fit to eat at once.

children.text: sneho vā goraso vāpi tatra śuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: If there is oiliness or cow's milk product there, how is there purification?

children.text: alpaṃ parityajet tatra snehasyotpavanena ca
children.translated_text: There one should discard a little, and by fanning the grease as well,

children.text: analajvālayā śuddhir gorasasya vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: purification of cow products is prescribed by the flame of fire.

children.text: Chapter 7
athāto dravyaśuddhis tu parāśaravaco yathā
children.translated_text: Now then, purification of substances is according to the word of <s>Parāśara</s>:

children.text: dāravāṇāṃ pātrāṇāṃ takṣaṇācchuddhir iṣyate ||
children.translated_text: for wooden vessels, purification is accepted through scraping.

children.text: bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ tāmramamlena śudhyati
children.translated_text: Bronze is purified with ashes; copper is purified with acid.

children.text: rajasā śudhyate nārī vikalaṃ yā na gacchati ||
children.translated_text: A woman is purified by menstruation, if she does not go while impaired.

children.text: nadī vegena śudhyeta lopo yadi na dṛśyate
children.translated_text: A river is purified by its current, if no loss of flow is seen.

children.text: vāpīkūpataḍāgeṣu dūṣiteṣu kathaṃcana ||
children.translated_text: When reservoirs, wells, and ponds have somehow been polluted,

children.text: uddhṛtya vai ghaṭaśataṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati
children.translated_text: after drawing out a hundred pots, they are purified with <s>pañcagavya</s> (the five products of the cow).

children.text: aṣṭavarṣā bhaved gaurī navavarṣā tu rohiṇī ||
children.translated_text: At eight years she is <s>Gaurī</s>; at nine years she is <s>Rohiṇī</s>.

children.text: daśavarṣā bhavet kanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā
children.translated_text: At ten years she is a maiden; after that she is menstruating.

children.text: prāpte tu dvādaśe varṣe yaḥ kanyāṃ na prayacchati ||
children.translated_text: But when the twelfth year has arrived, the man who does not give the girl in marriage,

children.text: māsi māsi rajas tasyāḥ pibanti pitaraḥ svayam
children.translated_text: month by month his ancestors themselves drink her menstrual blood.

children.text: mātā caiva pitā caiva jyeṣṭho bhrātā tathaiva ca ||
children.translated_text: The mother, the father, and likewise the eldest brother:

children.text: trayas te narakaṃ yānti dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ rajasvalām
children.translated_text: these three go to hell after seeing a girl menstruating.

children.text: yas tāṃ samudvahet kanyāṃ brāhmaṇo madamohitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The brahmin who, deluded by intoxication, marries that girl

children.text: asaṃbhāṣyo hy apāṅkteyaḥ sa vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ
children.translated_text: is not to be spoken to and is excluded from the meal-line; that twice-born man is the husband of a <s>vṛṣalī</s> (low-caste woman).

children.text: yaḥ karoty ekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanaṃ dvijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A twice-born man who commits the service of a <s>vṛṣalī</s> for one single night,

children.text: sa bhaikṣabhuj japan nityaṃ tribhir varṣair viśudhyati
children.translated_text: eating alms and constantly reciting, becomes purified in three years.

children.text: astaṃ gate yadā sūrye caṇḍālaṃ patitaṃ striyam ||
children.translated_text: When, after the sun has set, one touches a <s>caṇḍāla</s>, an outcaste, a woman,

children.text: sūtikāṃ spṛśataś caiva kathaṃ śuddhir vidhīyate
children.translated_text: or a woman who has recently given birth, how is purification prescribed?

children.text: jātavedaḥsuvarṇaṃ ca somamārgaṃ vilokya ca ||
children.translated_text: Having looked upon fire, gold, and the path of the moon,

children.text: brāhmaṇānumataś caiva snānaṃ kṛtvā viśudhyati
children.translated_text: and with a brahmin's approval, he becomes purified after bathing.

children.text: spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇī tathā ||
children.translated_text: When a brahmin woman and likewise another brahmin woman touch one another while menstruating,

children.text: tāvat tiṣṭhen nirāhārā trirātreṇaiva śudhyati
children.translated_text: she should remain without food for that long; she is purified in three nights.

children.text: spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā tathā ||
children.translated_text: When a brahmin woman and likewise a kṣatriya woman touch one another while menstruating,

children.text: ardhakṛcchraṃ caret pūrvā pādam ekam anantarā
children.translated_text: the former should perform a half-<s>kṛcchra</s> (penance), and the latter one quarter.

children.text: spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī vaiśyajā tathā ||
children.translated_text: When a brahmin woman and likewise a woman born as a vaiśya touch one another while menstruating,

children.text: pādahīnaṃ caret pūrvā pādam ekam anantarā
children.translated_text: the former should perform a penance lacking one quarter, and the latter one quarter.

children.text: spṛṣṭvā rajasvalānyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī śūdrajā tathā ||
children.translated_text: When a brahmin woman and likewise a woman born as a śūdra touch one another while menstruating,

children.text: kṛcchreṇa śudhyate pūrvā śūdrā dānena śudhyati
children.translated_text: the former is purified by a <s>kṛcchra</s> (penance); the śūdra woman is purified by a gift.

children.text: snātā rajasvalā yā tu caturthe 'hani śudhyati ||
children.translated_text: A menstruating woman, having bathed, becomes pure on the fourth day.

children.text: kuryād rajo nivṛttau tu daivapitryādi karma ca
children.translated_text: When menstruation has ceased, she may perform rites for the gods and ancestors and the like.

children.text: rogeṇa yad rajaḥ strīṇām anvahaṃ tu pravartate ||
children.translated_text: When the menstrual flow of women proceeds every day because of illness,

children.text: nāśuciḥ sā tatas tena tat syād vaikālikaṃ matam
children.translated_text: she is not impure on account of that; that is considered an exceptional condition.

children.text: sādhvācārā na tāvat syād rajo yāvat pravartate ||
children.translated_text: She is not of proper conduct so long as the menstrual flow continues.

children.text: rajonivṛttau gamyā strī gṛhakarmaṇi caiva hi
children.translated_text: When menstruation has ceased, a woman is approachable, and also in household work.

children.text: prathame 'hani caṇḍālī dvitīye brahmaghātinī ||
children.translated_text: On the first day she is a <s>caṇḍālī</s>; on the second, a slayer of a brahmin.

children.text: tṛtīye rajakī proktā caturthe 'hani śudhyati
children.translated_text: On the third she is called a washerwoman; on the fourth day she becomes pure.

children.text: āture snānotpanne daśakṛtvo hy anāturaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When a sick person has occasion for bathing, a healthy man, ten times over,

children.text: snātvā snātvā spṛśed enaṃ tataḥ śudhyet sa āturaḥ
children.translated_text: should bathe again and again and touch him; then that sick person becomes pure.

children.text: ucchiṣṭocchiṣṭasaṃspṛṣṭaḥ śunā śūdreṇa vā dvijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A twice-born man who is touched by one with leavings, or by a dog or a śūdra with leavings,

children.text: upoṣya rajanīm ekāṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati
children.translated_text: is purified by fasting one night and by <s>pañcagavya</s>.

children.text: anucchiṣṭena śūdreṇa sparśe snānaṃ vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: When there is contact with a śūdra who has no leavings, bathing is prescribed.

children.text: tenocchiṣṭena saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prājāpatyaṃ samācaret
children.translated_text: Touched by that same one with leavings, he should perform the <s>prājāpatya</s> (expiation).

children.text: bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ surayā yan na lipyate ||
children.translated_text: Bronze is purified with ashes when it is not smeared with liquor.

children.text: surāmātreṇa saṃspṛṣṭaṃ śudhyate 'gnyupalekhanaiḥ
children.translated_text: If it is merely touched by liquor, it is purified by smearing with fire.

children.text: gavāghrātāni kāṃsyāni śvakākopahatāni ca ||
children.translated_text: Bronze vessels smelled by a cow, damaged by a dog or a crow,

children.text: śudhyanti daśabhiḥ kṣāraiḥ śūdrocchiṣṭāni yāni ca
children.translated_text: and those made leavings by a śūdra are purified with ten alkaline washes.

children.text: gaṇḍūṣaṃ pādaśaucaṃ ca kṛtvā vai kāṃsyabhājane ||
children.translated_text: If one has rinsed the mouth or washed the feet in a bronze vessel,

children.text: ṣaṇmāsān bhuvi niḥkṣipya uddhṛtya punar āharet
children.translated_text: one should bury it in the earth for six months, then take it out and use it again.

children.text: āyaseṣv āyasānāṃ ca sīsasyāgnau viśodhanam ||
children.translated_text: For iron things and things made of iron, and for lead, purification is in fire.

children.text: dantam asthi tathā bhṛṅgaṃ rūpyaṃ sauvarṇabhājanam
children.translated_text: Ivory, bone, horn, silver, and golden vessels,

children.text: maṇipāṣāṇapātrāṇīty etān prakṣālayej jalaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: and vessels of jewels and stone: these one should wash with water.

children.text: pāṣāṇe tu punar gharṣaḥ śuddhir evam udāhṛtā
children.translated_text: For stone, however, there is further rubbing; thus purification is declared.

children.text: mṛṇmaye dahanācchuddhir dhānyānāṃ mārjanād api ||
children.translated_text: For earthenware purification is by burning; for grains, also by wiping.

children.text: veṇuvalkalacīrāṇāṃ kṣaumakārpāsavāsasām
children.translated_text: For bamboo, bark, rags, linen, cotton garments,

children.text: aurṇanetrapaṭānāṃ ca prokṣaṇācchuddhir iṣyate ||
children.translated_text: and woolen, silk, and cloth fabrics, purification is accepted through sprinkling.

children.text: muñjopaskaraśūrpāṇāṃ śaṇasya phalacarmaṇām
children.translated_text: For articles of muñja grass, winnowing baskets, hemp, fruits, and skins,

children.text: tṛṇakāṣṭhasya rajjūṇām udakābhyukṣaṇaṃ matam ||
children.translated_text: and for grass, wood, and ropes, sprinkling with water is considered proper.

children.text: tūlikādyupadhānāni raktavastrādikāni ca
children.translated_text: Cushions and pillows and the like, and red garments and the like,

children.text: śoṣayitvātapenaiva prokṣaṇācchuddhitām iyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: after being dried in the sun, attain purity through sprinkling alone.

children.text: mārjāramakṣikākīṭapataṅgakṛmidardurāḥ
children.translated_text: Cats, flies, insects, moths, worms, and frogs,

children.text: medhyāmedhyaṃ spṛśanto 'pi nocchiṣṭaṃ manur abravīt ||
children.translated_text: even when they touch what is pure or impure, <s>Manu</s> said, do not make it leavings.

children.text: mahīṃ spṛṣṭvāgataṃ toyaṃ yāś cāpy anyonyavipruṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Water that has touched the earth and then come, and drops that splash from one thing to another,

children.text: bhuktocchiṣṭaṃ tathā snehaṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ manur abravīt ||
children.translated_text: and likewise grease left after eating: <s>Manu</s> said these are not leavings.

children.text: tāmbūlekṣuphale caiva bhuktasnehānulepane
children.translated_text: In betel, sugarcane, and fruit, and in smearing with grease from food,

children.text: madhuparke ca some ca nocchiṣṭaṃ dharmato viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: and in the <s>madhuparka</s> and in soma, they know by dharma that there are no leavings.

children.text: rathyākardamatoyāni nāvaḥ panthās tṛṇāni ca
children.translated_text: Roadside mud and waters, boats, paths, and grasses,

children.text: mārutārkeṇa śudhyanti pakveṣṭakacitāni ca ||
children.translated_text: and things built of baked bricks, are purified by wind and sun.

children.text: aduṣṭā saṃtatā dhārā vātoddhūtāś ca reṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: A continuous stream is unpolluted, and so are dust particles raised by the wind.

children.text: striyo vṛddhāś ca bālāś ca na duṣyanti kadācana ||
children.translated_text: Women, old people, and children are never defiled.

children.text: deśabhaṅge pravāse vā vyādhiṣu vyasaneṣv api
children.translated_text: When a country is broken, or in exile, illnesses, or even calamities,

children.text: rakṣed eva svadehādi paścād dharmaṃ samācaret ||
children.translated_text: one should preserve one's own body and the like; afterwards one should practice dharma.

children.text: yena kena ca dharmeṇa mṛdunā dāruṇena vā
children.translated_text: By whatever dharma is possible, whether gentle or harsh.

children.text: uddhared dīnam ātmānaṃ samartho dharmam ācaret ||
children.translated_text: One who is able should rescue his afflicted self and then practice <s>dharma</s> (normative duty).

children.text: āpatkāle tu nistīrṇe śaucācāraṃ tu cintayet
children.translated_text: But when the time of calamity has been crossed, one should consider purity and proper conduct.

children.text: śuddhiṃ samuddharet paścāt svastho dharmaṃ samācaret ||
children.translated_text: Afterwards one should restore purification; being well, one should properly practice <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 8
gavāṃ bandhanayoktreṣu bhaven mṛtyur akāmataḥ
children.translated_text: When death occurs unintentionally through the tethering straps and yokes of cows,

children.text: akāmakṛtapāpasya prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: what should be the expiation for a sin done without intention?

children.text: vedavedāṅgaviduṣāṃ dharmaśāstraṃ vijānatām
children.translated_text: To those learned in the Veda and Vedāṅgas, who know the <s>dharmaśāstra</s>,

children.text: svakarmarataviprāṇāṃ svakaṃ pāpaṃ nivedayet ||
children.translated_text: to brahmins devoted to their own proper duties, one should declare one’s own sin.

children.text: sāvitryāś cāpi gāyatryāḥ saṃdhyopāstyagnikāryayoḥ
children.translated_text: With respect to the <s>Sāvitrī</s> and the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, to the worship at twilight and the fire-rite,

children.text: ajñānāt kṛṣikartāro brāhmaṇā nāmadhārakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: brahmins who, through ignorance, engage in agriculture are brahmins in name only.

children.text: avratānām amantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām
children.translated_text: For those without vows, without mantras, and living merely by birth-status,

children.text: sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: even if they are assembled by the thousand, there is no status as a council.

children.text: yad vadanti tamomūḍhā mūrkhā dharmam atadvidaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever dharma those fools, darkened by ignorance and not knowing it, declare,

children.text: tat pāpaṃ śatadhā bhūtvā tadvaktṝn adhigacchati ||
children.translated_text: that sin, becoming a hundredfold, goes to those who speak it.

children.text: ajñātvā dharmaśāstrāṇi prāyaścittaṃ dadāti yaḥ
children.translated_text: One who assigns expiation without knowing the <s>dharmaśāstras</s>:

children.text: prāyaścittī bhavet pūtaḥ kilbiṣaṃ parṣadi vrajet ||
children.translated_text: the penitent may become purified, but the guilt goes to the council.

children.text: catvāro vā trayo vāpi yaṃ brūyur vedapāragāḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever four, or even three, men who have crossed to the far shore of the Veda declare,

children.text: sa dharmeti vijñeyo netarais tu sahasraśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that is to be understood as <s>dharma</s>, not what others declare even by the thousand.

children.text: pramāṇamārgaṃ mārganto ye dharmaṃ pravadanti vai
children.translated_text: Those who, seeking the path of valid authority, proclaim <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: teṣām udvijate pāpaṃ sadbhūtaguṇavādinām ||
children.translated_text: from them sin recoils, for they speak with real and virtuous qualities.

children.text: yathāśmani sthitaṃ toyaṃ mārutārkeṇa śudhyati
children.translated_text: As water standing on a stone is purified by wind and sun,

children.text: evaṃ pariṣadādeśān nāśayet tasya duṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: so, by the order of a council, one should destroy that person’s wrongdoing.

children.text: naiva gacchati kartāraṃ naiva gacchati parṣadam
children.translated_text: It does not go to the doer, nor does it go to the council;

children.text: mārutārkādisaṃyogāt pāpaṃ naśyati toyavat ||
children.translated_text: through contact with wind, sun, and the like, sin perishes like water.

children.text: catvāro vā trayo vāpi vedavanto 'gnihotriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Four, or even three, men possessing the Veda and maintaining the <s>agnihotra</s>,

children.text: brāhmaṇānāṃ samarthā ye pariṣat sābhidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: who are competent among brahmins: that is called a council.

children.text: anāhitāgnayo ye 'nye vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ
children.translated_text: Other men who have not established the sacred fires, but have mastered the Veda and Vedāṅgas,

children.text: pañca trayo vā dharmajñāḥ pariṣat sā prakīrtitā ||
children.translated_text: five or three knowers of <s>dharma</s>: that is proclaimed to be a council.

children.text: munīnām ātmavidyānāṃ dvijānāṃ yajñayājinām
children.translated_text: Among sages, knowers of the self, twice-born sacrificers of sacrifices,

children.text: vedavrateṣu snātānām eko 'pi pariṣad bhavet ||
children.translated_text: and those who have completed their bath in Vedic vows, even one may be a council.

children.text: pañca pūrvaṃ mayā proktās teṣāṃ cāsaṃbhave trayaḥ
children.translated_text: Five were first declared by me; when they are unavailable, three;

children.text: svavṛttiparituṣṭo ye pariṣat sā prakīrtitā ||
children.translated_text: those who are content with their own livelihood are proclaimed to be a council.

children.text: ata ūrdhvaṃ tu ye viprāḥ kevalaṃ nāmadhārakāḥ
children.translated_text: But beyond these, brahmins who are merely bearers of the name:

children.text: pariṣattvaṃ na teṣv asti sahasraguṇiteṣv api ||
children.translated_text: there is no council-status among them, even if multiplied a thousand times.

children.text: yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ
children.translated_text: As an elephant made of wood, as a deer made of leather,

children.text: brāhmaṇas tv anadhīyānas trayas te nāmadhārakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: so a brahmin who does not study: these three are bearers of the name only.

children.text: grāmasthānaṃ yathā śūnyaṃ yathā kūpas tu nirjalaḥ
children.translated_text: As a village site is empty, as a well is without water,

children.text: yathā hutam anagnau ca amantro brāhmaṇas tathā ||
children.translated_text: and as an oblation offered without fire, so is a brahmin without mantra.

children.text: yathā ṣaṇḍho 'phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaur ūṣarāphalā
children.translated_text: As a eunuch is fruitless among women, as a barren cow is fruitless,

children.text: yathā cājñe 'phalaṃ dānaṃ tathā vipro 'nṛco 'phalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and as a gift to an ignorant man is fruitless, so is a brahmin without ṛg-verses fruitless.

children.text: citrakarma yathānekair aṅgair unmīlyate śanaiḥ
children.translated_text: As a painted work is gradually opened out by its many limbs,

children.text: brāhmaṇyam api tadvaddhi saṃskārair mantrapūrvakaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: so indeed brahminhood is formed by consecrations preceded by mantras.

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ prayacchanti ye dvijā nāmadhārakāḥ
children.translated_text: Those twice-born men who are brahmins in name only and assign expiation:

children.text: te dvijāḥ pāpakarmāṇaḥ sametā narakaṃ yayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: those twice-born men, doers of evil deeds, have gone together to hell.

children.text: ye paṭhanti dvijā vedaṃ pañcayajñaratāś ca ye
children.translated_text: Those twice-born men who recite the Veda and are devoted to the five sacrifices,

children.text: trailokyaṃ tārayanty ete pañcendriyaratā api ||
children.translated_text: even though attached to the five senses, these carry the three worlds across.

children.text: sampraṇītaḥ śmaśāneṣu dīpto 'gniḥ sarvabhakṣakaḥ
children.translated_text: A blazing fire, properly kindled in cremation grounds, consumes everything;

children.text: evaṃ ca vedavid vipraḥ sarvabhakṣo 'pi daivatam ||
children.translated_text: so too a Veda-knowing brahmin, even if he eats all kinds of food, is divine.

children.text: amedhyāni tu sarvāṇi prakṣipyante yathodake
children.translated_text: As all impure things are cast into water,

children.text: tathaiva kilbiṣaṃ sarvaṃ prakṣipecca dvijānale ||
children.translated_text: just so one should cast every sin into the fire that is the twice-born man.

children.text: gāyatrīrahito vipraḥ śūdrād apy aśucir bhavet
children.translated_text: A brahmin without the <s>Gāyatrī</s> would be more impure even than a śūdra.

children.text: gāyatrībrahmatattvajñāḥ sampūjyante janair dvijāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Twice-born men who know the truth of the <s>Gāyatrī</s> and <s>Brahman</s> are honored by people.

children.text: duḥśīlo 'pi dvijaḥ pūjyo na tu śūdro jitendriyaḥ
children.translated_text: Even a twice-born man of bad conduct is to be honored, but not a śūdra who has conquered his senses.

children.text: kaḥ parityajya gāṃ duṣṭāṃ duhecchīlavatīṃ kharīm ||
children.translated_text: Who, abandoning a bad cow, would milk a she-ass of good conduct?

children.text: dharmaśāstrarathārūḍhā vedakhaḍgadharā dvijāḥ
children.translated_text: Twice-born men mounted on the chariot of <s>dharmaśāstra</s> and holding the sword of the Veda:

children.text: krīḍārtham api yad brūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whatever they say even in play is remembered as the highest <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: cāturvedyo vikalpī ca aṅgavid dharmapāṭhakaḥ
children.translated_text: One versed in the four Vedas, one skilled in alternatives, a knower of the ancillary sciences, a reciter of <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: trayaś ca āśramo mukhyāḥ parṣad eṣā daśāvarā ||
children.translated_text: and three chief men of the āśramas: this is the council of at least ten.

children.text: rājñaś cānumate sthitvā prāyaścittam vinirdiśet
children.translated_text: Standing with the king’s permission, one should prescribe expiation;

children.text: svayam eva na kartavyaṃ kartavyā svalpaniṣkṛtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: it should not be done by oneself alone; a small atonement should be performed.

children.text: brāhmaṇāṃs tān atikramya rājā kartuṃ yad icchati
children.translated_text: Whatever the king wishes to do after disregarding those brahmins,

children.text: tat pāpaṃ śatadhā bhūtvā rājānam anugacchati ||
children.translated_text: that sin, becoming a hundredfold, follows the king.

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ sadā dadyād devatāyatanāgrataḥ
children.translated_text: One should always assign expiation in front of a shrine of the deity.

children.text: ātmakṛcchraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā japed vai vedamātaram ||
children.translated_text: Then, having performed self-mortification, one should recite the mother of the Veda.

children.text: saśikhaṃ vapanaṃ kṛtvā trisaṃdhyam avagāhanam
children.translated_text: Having shaved the head while leaving the topknot, and bathing at the three twilights,

children.text: gavāṃ madhye vased rātrau divā gāś cāpy anuvrajet ||
children.translated_text: one should dwell among cows at night and follow the cows by day.

children.text: uṣṇe varṣati śīte vā mārute vāti vā bhṛśam
children.translated_text: Whether in heat, in rain, in cold, or when the wind blows fiercely,

children.text: na kurvītātmanas trāṇaṃ gor akṛtvā tu śaktitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: one should not protect oneself without first protecting the cow to the extent of one’s ability.

children.text: ātmano yadi vānyeṣāṃ gṛhe kṣetre khale 'tha vā
children.translated_text: If, in one’s own or another’s house, field, or threshing-floor,

children.text: bhakṣayantīṃ na kathayet pibantaṃ caiva vatsakam ||
children.translated_text: a cow is eating, one should not report her, nor a calf that is drinking.

children.text: pibantīṣu pibet toyaṃ saṃviśantīṣu saṃviśet
children.translated_text: When they drink, one should drink water; when they lie down, one should lie down.

children.text: patitāṃ paṅkamagnāṃ vā sarvaprāṇaiḥ samuddharet ||
children.translated_text: A cow that has fallen or is sunk in mud one should lift out with all one’s life-breaths.

children.text: brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā yas tu prāṇān parityajet
children.translated_text: Whoever gives up his life for the sake of a brahmin or for the sake of a cow

children.text: mucyate brahmahatyāyā goptā gor brāhmaṇasya ca ||
children.translated_text: is released from brahmin-murder, being a protector of the cow and the brahmin.

children.text: govadhasyānurūpeṇa prājāpatyaṃ vinirdiśet
children.translated_text: In proportion to cow-killing, one should prescribe the <s>prājāpatya</s> (expiation).

children.text: prājāpatyaṃ tataḥ kṛcchraṃ vibhajet taccaturvidham ||
children.translated_text: Then he should divide the <s>prājāpatya</s> <s>kṛcchra</s> (penance); it is fourfold.

children.text: ekāham ekabhaktāśī ekāhaṃ naktabhojanaḥ
children.translated_text: For one day he eats one meal; for one day he eats at night;

children.text: ayācitāśy ekam ahar ekāhaṃ mārutāśanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for one day he eats what is not begged for; for one day he lives on air.

children.text: dinadvayaṃ caikabhakto dvidinaṃ caikabhojanaḥ
children.translated_text: For two days he eats one meal, and for two days he eats once;

children.text: dinadvayam ayācī syād dvidinaṃ mārutāśanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for two days he should eat unasked food, and for two days he should live on air.

children.text: tridinaṃ caikabhaktāśī tridinaṃ naktabhojanaḥ
children.translated_text: For three days he eats one meal, and for three days he eats at night;

children.text: dinatrayam ayācī syāt tridinaṃ mārutāśanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for three days he should eat unasked food, and for three days he should live on air.

children.text: caturahaṃ caikabhaktāśī caturahaṃ naktabhojanaḥ
children.translated_text: For four days he eats one meal, and for four days he eats at night;

children.text: caturdinam ayācī syāc caturahaṃ mārutāśanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for four days he should eat unasked food, and for four days he should live on air.

children.text: prāyaścitte tataś cīrṇe kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam
children.translated_text: Then, when the expiation has been performed, he should feed brahmins.

children.text: viprāṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pavitrāṇi japed dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: The twice-born man should give a fee to the brahmins and recite purifying texts.

children.text: brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu goghnaḥ śuddho na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After feeding brahmins, the killer of a cow is purified; there is no doubt.

children.text: Chapter 9
gavāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya na duṣyed rodhabandhayoḥ
children.translated_text: For the sake of protecting cows, one is not at fault in restraining or binding them.

children.text: tadvadhaṃ tu na taṃ vidyāt kāmākāmakṛtaṃ tathā ||
children.translated_text: Likewise, one should not regard that as their killing, whether done intentionally or unintentionally.

children.text: daṇḍād ūrdhvaṃ yad anyena prahārād yadi pātayet
children.translated_text: If, beyond the rod, he brings it down by another blow or by striking it,

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ tadā proktaṃ dviguṇaṃ govadhe caret ||
children.translated_text: then expiation is prescribed; in the case of cow-killing he should perform it doubled.

children.text: rodhabandhanayoktrāṇi ghātaś ceti caturvidham
children.translated_text: Restraint, binding, yoking, and striking are fourfold.

children.text: ekapādaṃ cared rodhe dvau pādau bandhane caret ||
children.translated_text: For restraint he should perform one quarter; for binding he should perform two quarters.

children.text: yoktreṣu pādahīnaṃ syāc caret sarvaṃ nipātane
children.translated_text: For yokes it should be one quarter less; for causing it to fall he should perform the whole penance.

children.text: govāṭe vā gṛhe vāpi durge vāpy asamasthale ||
children.translated_text: Whether in a cow-pen, in a house, in a difficult place, or on uneven ground,

children.text: nadīṣv atha samudreṣu tv anyeṣu na nadīmukhe
children.translated_text: or in rivers and seas, but not at the mouth of a river or in other such places,

children.text: dagdhadeśe mṛtā gāvaḥ stambhanād rodha ucyate ||
children.translated_text: cows that die in a burnt place because of confinement: this is called restraint.

children.text: yoktradāmakadoraiś ca kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ
children.translated_text: With yoke-straps, cords, ropes, and ornaments decorating the neck,

children.text: gṛhe vāpi vane vāpi baddhā syād gaur mṛtā yadi ||
children.translated_text: if a cow is tied in a house or in a forest and dies,

children.text: tad eva bandhanaṃ vidyāt kāmākāmakṛtaṃ ca yat
children.translated_text: one should know that very thing as binding, whether it was done intentionally or unintentionally.

children.text: hale vā śakaṭe paṅktau pṛṣṭhe vā pīḍito naraiḥ ||
children.translated_text: If, at a plough, in a cart, in a line, or on its back, it is oppressed by men,

children.text: gopatir mṛtyum āpnoti yoktro bhavati tadvadhaḥ
children.translated_text: and the cow's owner incurs death, that killing is due to yoking.

children.text: mattaḥ pramatta unmattaś cetano vāpy acetanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whether drunk, negligent, deranged, conscious, or unconscious,

children.text: kāmākāmakṛtakrodho daṇḍair hanyād athopalaiḥ
children.translated_text: whether acting intentionally or unintentionally or in anger, if he strikes it with sticks or stones,

children.text: prahṛtā vā mṛtā vāpi taddhi hetur nipātane ||
children.translated_text: and it is struck or dies, that is indeed the cause in causing it to fall.

children.text: aṅguṣṭhamātrasthūlas tu bāhumātraḥ pramāṇataḥ
children.translated_text: A stick that is as thick as a thumb and, in measure, as long as an arm,

children.text: ādras tu sapalāśaś ca daṇḍa ity abhidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: and is fresh and leafy, is called a rod.

children.text: mūrchitaḥ patito vāpi daṇḍenābhihitaḥ sa tu
children.translated_text: But if it is stunned or fallen after being hit with a rod,

children.text: utthitas tu yadā gacchet pañca sapta daśaiva vā ||
children.translated_text: and, having risen, then goes five, seven, or even ten steps,

children.text: grāsaṃ vā yadi gṛhṇīyāt toyaṃ vāpi pibed yadi
children.translated_text: or if it takes a mouthful of grass, or if it drinks water,

children.text: pūrvaṃ vyādhyupasṛṣṭaś cet prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: and if it had previously been afflicted by disease, there is no expiation.

children.text: piṇḍasthe pādam ekaṃ tu dvau pādau garbhasaṃmite
children.translated_text: When the embryo is a lump, there is one quarter; when it is equal to a fetus, two quarters.

children.text: pādonaṃ vratam uddiṣṭaṃ hatvā garbham acetanam ||
children.translated_text: A vow lacking one quarter is prescribed for killing an unconscious embryo.

children.text: pāde 'ṅgaromavapanaṃ dvipāde śmaśruṇo 'pi ca
children.translated_text: For one quarter there is shaving of body hair; for two quarters, also of the beard.

children.text: tripāde tu śikhāvarjaṃ saśikhaṃ tu nipātane ||
children.translated_text: For three quarters, everything except the topknot; for killing, together with the topknot.

children.text: pāde vastrayugaṃ caiva dvipāde kāṃsyabhājanam
children.translated_text: For one quarter he should give a pair of garments; for two quarters, a bronze vessel.

children.text: tripāde govṛṣaṃ dadyāc caturthe godvayaṃ smṛtam ||
children.translated_text: For three quarters he should give a cow and bull; for the fourth, two cows are prescribed.

children.text: niṣpannasarvagātras tu dṛśyate vā sacetanaḥ
children.translated_text: But if it is fully formed in all its limbs and is seen to be conscious,

children.text: aṅgapratyaṅgasampūrṇo dviguṇaṃ govrataṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: complete in its major and minor limbs, he should perform the cow-vow doubled.

children.text: pāṣāṇenātha daṇḍena gāvo yenābhighātitāḥ
children.translated_text: If cows are struck by someone with a stone or a stick,

children.text: śṛṅgabhaṅge caret pādaṃ dvau pādau netraghātane ||
children.translated_text: for breaking a horn he should perform one quarter; for injuring an eye, two quarters.

children.text: lāṅgūle pādakṛcchraṃ tu dvau pādāv asthibhañjane
children.translated_text: For the tail there is a quarter-<s>kṛcchra</s>; for breaking a bone, two quarters.

children.text: tripādaṃ caiva karṇe tu caret sarvaṃ nipātane ||
children.translated_text: For the ear, three quarters; for causing it to fall, he should perform the whole penance.

children.text: śṛṅgabhaṅge 'sthibhaṅge ca kaṭibhaṅge tathaiva ca
children.translated_text: When a horn is broken, a bone is broken, or the hip is broken likewise,

children.text: yadi jīvati ṣaṇmāsān prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: if it lives for six months, there is no expiation.

children.text: vraṇabhaṅge ca kartavyaḥ snehābhyaṅgas tu pāṇinā
children.translated_text: When a wound has broken open, an anointing with oil should be done by hand,

children.text: yavasaś copahartavyo yāvad dṛḍhabalo bhavet ||
children.translated_text: and fodder should be brought until it becomes firm and strong.

children.text: yāvat sampūrṇasarvāṅgas tāvat taṃ poṣayen naraḥ
children.translated_text: A man should nourish it until all its limbs are whole.

children.text: gorūpaṃ brāhmaṇasyāgre namaskṛtvā visarjayet ||
children.translated_text: Then, after bowing before a brahmin to the cow-form, he should release it.

children.text: yady asaṃpūrṇasargāṅgo hīnadeho bhavet tadā
children.translated_text: If then it is not whole in all its limbs, and its body is deficient,

children.text: goghātakasya tasyārthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet ||
children.translated_text: one should prescribe an expiation for that cow-killer on account of it.

children.text: kāṣṭhaloṣṭakapāṣāṇaiḥ śastreṇaivoddhato balāt
children.translated_text: Whoever violently kills a cow with wood, a clod, stones, or a weapon,

children.text: vyāpādayati yo gāṃ tu tasya śuddhiṃ vinirdiśet ||
children.translated_text: one should prescribe the purification for him.

children.text: caret sāṃtapanaṃ kāṣṭhe prājāpatyaṃ tu loṣṭake
children.translated_text: For wood he should perform the <s>sāṃtapana</s>; for a clod, the <s>prājāpatya</s>.

children.text: taptakṛcchraṃ tu pāṣāṇe śastre caivātikṛcchrakam ||
children.translated_text: For a stone, the heated <s>kṛcchra</s>; and for a weapon, the very severe <s>kṛcchra</s>.

children.text: pañca saṃtapane gāvaḥ prājāpatye tathā trayaḥ
children.translated_text: In the <s>sāṃtapana</s> there are five cows; in the <s>prājāpatya</s>, likewise, three.

children.text: taptakṛcchre bhavanty aṣṭāv atikṛcchre trayodaśa ||
children.translated_text: In the heated <s>kṛcchra</s> there are eight, and in the very severe <s>kṛcchra</s>, thirteen.

children.text: pramāpaṇe prāṇabhṛtāṃ dadyāt tat pratirūpakam
children.translated_text: For the killing of living beings, one should give something corresponding to it,

children.text: tasyānurūpaṃ mūlyaṃ vā dadyād ity abravīn manuḥ ||
children.translated_text: or one should give a value equivalent to it; so said <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: anyatrāṅkanalakṣmabhyāṃ vāhane mocane tathā
children.translated_text: Except in branding with marks, and likewise in carrying and releasing,

children.text: sāyaṃ saṃgopanārthaṃ ca na duṣyed rodhabandhayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: and for enclosing them in the evening for protection, one is not at fault in restraint or binding.

children.text: atidāhe 'tivāhe ca nāsikābhedane tathā
children.translated_text: For excessive burning, excessive carrying, and likewise piercing the nose,

children.text: nadīparvatasaṃcāre prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet ||
children.translated_text: and for passage through rivers and mountains, expiation is prescribed.

children.text: atidāhe caret pādaṃ dvau pādau vāhane caret
children.translated_text: For excessive burning he should perform one quarter; for carrying, two quarters.

children.text: nāsikye padahīnaṃ tu caret sarvaṃ nipātane ||
children.translated_text: For a nasal injury, one quarter less; for causing it to fall, he should perform the whole penance.

children.text: dahanāt tu vipadyate anaḍvān yoktrayantritaḥ
children.translated_text: But if a yoked ox, constrained by the yoke, perishes from burning,

children.text: uktaṃ parāśareṇaiva hy ekapādaṃ yathāvidhi ||
children.translated_text: a one-quarter penance has been stated by <s>Parāśara</s> himself, according to rule.

children.text: rodhanaṃ bandhanaṃ caiva bhāraḥ praharaṇaṃ tathā
children.translated_text: Confinement, binding, burden, and striking,

children.text: durgapreraṇayoktraṃ ca nimittāni vadhasya ṣaṭ ||
children.translated_text: driving into difficult ground, and yoking: these are the six causes of killing.

children.text: bandhapāśasuguptāṅgo mriyate yadi gopaśuḥ
children.translated_text: If a cow or ox dies with its limbs well secured by bonds and nooses,

children.text: bhavane tasya pāpī syāt prāyaścittārdham arhati ||
children.translated_text: in his house, he would be sinful and deserves half of the expiation.

children.text: na nārikelair na ca śāṇavālaiḥ na vāpi mauñjair na ca valkaśṛṅkhalaiḥ
children.translated_text: Not with coconut fibers, nor with hempen cords, nor with cords of muñja grass, nor with chains of bark:

children.text: etais tu gāvo na nibandhanīyā baddhvāpi tiṣṭhet paraśuṃ gṛhītvā ||
children.translated_text: cows are not to be tied with these; even after tying them, one should stand holding an axe.

children.text: kuśaiḥ kāśaiś ca badhnīyād gopaśuṃ dakṣiṇāmukham
children.translated_text: One should tie a cow or other domestic animal, facing south, with kuśa and kāśa grass.

children.text: pāśalagnāgnidagdhāsu prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: For those caught in a noose or burned by fire, there is no expiation.

children.text: yadi tatra bhavet kāṣṭhaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet
children.translated_text: If there should be wood there, how would there be expiation?

children.text: japitvā pāvanīṃ devīṃ mucyate tatra kilbiṣāt ||
children.translated_text: Having recited the purifying goddess, he is released there from guilt.

children.text: prerayan kūpavāpīṣu vṛkṣacchedeṣu pātayan
children.translated_text: Driving them into wells and reservoirs, and causing them to fall while cutting trees,

children.text: gavāśaneṣu vikrīṇaṃs tataḥ prāpnoti govadham ||
children.translated_text: and selling them for cow-slaughter: from that he incurs cow-killing.

children.text: ārādhitas tu yaḥ kaścid bhinnakakṣo yadā bhavet
children.translated_text: But if any one that has been cared for becomes split in the flank,

children.text: śravaṇaṃ hṛdayaṃ bhinnaṃ magno vā kūpasaṃkaṭe ||
children.translated_text: or its ear or heart is pierced, or it is sunk in the confinement of a well,

children.text: kūpād utkramaṇe caiva bhagno vā grīvapādayoḥ
children.translated_text: or, while climbing out of a well, its neck or feet are broken,

children.text: sa eva mriyate tatra trīn pādāṃs tu samācaret ||
children.translated_text: and it dies there from that very cause, he should perform three quarters of the penance.

children.text: kūpakhāṭe taṭābandhe nadībandhe prapāsu ca
children.translated_text: For those that perish in a well-pit, in an embanked bank, in a river-dam, or at watering places,

children.text: pānīyeṣu vipannānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: and in water sources, there is no expiation.

children.text: kūpakhāte taṭākhāte dīrghakhāte tathaiva ca
children.translated_text: In a well-pit, a bank-pit, a long trench, and likewise

children.text: anyeṣu dharmakhāteṣu prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: in other pits dug for religious purposes, there is no expiation.

children.text: veśmadvāre nivāseṣu yo naraḥ khātam icchati
children.translated_text: If a man wants a pit at the door of a house or in dwellings,

children.text: svakāryagṛhakhateṣu prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet ||
children.translated_text: one should prescribe expiation for pits dug for his own household purpose.

children.text: niśi bandhaniruddheṣu sarpavyāghrahateṣu ca
children.translated_text: For those confined by bonds at night, and for those killed by snakes or tigers,

children.text: agnividyudvipannānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: and for those destroyed by fire or lightning, there is no expiation.

children.text: grāmaghāte śaraugheṇa veśmabhaṅgān nipātane
children.translated_text: For those killed in the destruction of a village by a shower of arrows, by the collapse and fall of a house,

children.text: ativṛṣṭihatānāṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: and for those killed by excessive rain, there is no expiation.

children.text: saṃgrāme prahatānāṃ ca ye dagdhā veśmakeṣu ca
children.translated_text: For those struck down in battle, and those burned in houses,

children.text: dāvāgnigrāmaghāteṣu prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: and in forest fires and village-destructions, there is no expiation.

children.text: yantritā gauś cikitsārthaṃ mūḍhagarbhavimocane
children.translated_text: If a cow is restrained for the sake of treatment, in order to deliver a blocked fetus,

children.text: yatne kṛte vipadyeta prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: and, though effort has been made, it perishes, there is no expiation.

children.text: vyāpannānāṃ bahūnāṃ ca bandhane rodhane 'pi vā
children.translated_text: But for many that perish, whether in binding or in confinement,

children.text: bhiṣaṅmithyopacāre ca prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet ||
children.translated_text: and also in a physician's wrong treatment, one should prescribe expiation.

children.text: govṛṣāṇāṃ vipattau ca yāvantaḥ prekṣakā janāḥ
children.translated_text: When cows or bulls perish, as many people as are witnesses,

children.text: anivārayatāṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pātakaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: if they do not prevent it, there would be sin for all of them.

children.text: eko hato yair bahubhiḥ sametair na jñāyate yasya hato 'bhighātāt
children.translated_text: If one is killed by many assembled together, and it is not known by whose blow it was killed,

children.text: divyena teṣām upalabhya hantā nivartanīyo nṛpasaṃniyuktaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: after the killer among them has been found by ordeal, he is to be restrained by those appointed by the king.

children.text: ekā ced bahubhiḥ kācid daivād vyāpāditā yadi
children.translated_text: But if some single cow has been killed by many people by chance,

children.text: pādaṃ pādaṃ tu hatyāyāś careyus te pṛthak pṛthak ||
children.translated_text: they should each separately perform a quarter of the expiation for killing.

children.text: hate tu rudhiraṃ dṛśyaṃ vyādhigrastaḥ kṛśo bhavet
children.translated_text: When it has been killed, blood is visible; when diseased, it is emaciated.

children.text: lālā bhavati daṣṭeṣu evam anveṣaṇaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: There is saliva in the case of bites: in this way the investigation should be made.

children.text: grāsārthaṃ codito vāpi adhvānaṃ naiva gacchati
children.translated_text: Even when urged for the sake of fodder, it simply does not go on the road.

children.text: manunā caivam ekena sarvaśāstrāṇi jānatā ||
children.translated_text: And thus by <s>Manu</s> alone, who knew all the śāstras,

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ tu tenoktaṃ goghnaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
children.translated_text: expiation was declared: the cow-killer should perform the <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: keśānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya dviguṇaṃ vratam ācaret ||
children.translated_text: For the sake of preserving the hair, he should perform the vow doubled.

children.text: dviguṇe vrata ādiṣṭe dviguṇā dakṣiṇā bhavet
children.translated_text: When a doubled vow is prescribed, the fee should be doubled.

children.text: rājā vā rājaputro vā brāhmaṇo vā bahuśrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whether he is a king, a prince, or a very learned brahmin,

children.text: akṛtvā vapanaṃ tasya prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet
children.translated_text: without performing shaving, one should prescribe expiation for him.

children.text: sarvān keśān samuddhṛtya chedayed aṅguladvayam ||
children.translated_text: Having drawn up all the hair, one should cut off two finger-breadths.

children.text: evaṃ nārīkumārīṇāṃ śiraso muṇḍanaṃ smṛtam
children.translated_text: Thus the shaving of the head is remembered for women and unmarried girls.

children.text: na striyāḥ keśavapanaṃ na dūre śayanāśanam ||
children.translated_text: There is no shaving of a woman's hair, nor sleeping and eating at a distance,

children.text: na ca goṣṭhe vased rātrau na divā gā anuvrajet
children.translated_text: nor should she stay in the cow-pen at night, nor follow the cows by day,

children.text: nadīṣu saṃgame caiva araṇyeṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
children.translated_text: at river confluences and especially in forests.

children.text: na strīṇām ajinaṃ vāso vratam eva samācaret
children.translated_text: Nor is a skin the garment for women; she should simply perform the vow.

children.text: trisaṃdhyaṃ snānam ity uktaṃ surāṇām arcanaṃ tathā ||
children.translated_text: Bathing at the three twilights is prescribed, and likewise worship of the gods.

children.text: bandhumadhye vrataṃ tāsāṃ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādikam
children.translated_text: Their vow, such as the <s>kṛcchra</s>, <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>, and the rest, is to be performed among relatives.

children.text: gṛheṣu satataṃ tiṣṭhecchucir niyamam ācaret ||
children.translated_text: She should always remain in the house, pure, and observe the rule.

children.text: iha yo govadhaṃ kṛtvā pracchādayitum icchati
children.translated_text: Here, whoever, after committing cow-killing, wishes to conceal it

children.text: sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ kālasūtram asaṃśayam ||
children.translated_text: goes without doubt to the terrible hell <s>Kālasūtra</s>.

children.text: vimukto narakāt tasmān martyaloke prajāyate
children.translated_text: Released from that hell, he is born in the mortal world

children.text: klībo duḥkhī ca kuṣṭhī ca sapta janmāni vai naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: as impotent, miserable, and leprous for seven births.

children.text: tasmāt prakāśayet pāpaṃ svadharmaṃ satataṃ caret
children.translated_text: Therefore one should make the sin known and always practice one's own <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: strībālabhṛtyagovipreṣv atikopaṃ vivarjayet ||
children.translated_text: One should completely avoid excessive anger toward women, children, servants, cows, and brahmins.

children.text: Chapter 10
cāturvarṇyeṣu sarveṣu hitāṃ vakṣyāmi niṣkṛtim
children.translated_text: For all among the four varṇas I shall declare a beneficial expiation.

children.text: agamyāgamane caiva śuddhyai cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: For going to a woman who must not be approached, one should perform the <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> for purification.

children.text: ekaikaṃ hrāsayed grāsaṃ kṛṣṇe śukle ca vardhayet
children.translated_text: He should diminish the morsels one by one in the dark fortnight and increase them in the bright fortnight.

children.text: amāvāsyāṃ na bhuñjīta hy eṣa cāndrāyaṇo vidhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: On the new-moon day he should not eat; this is the rule of the <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇaṃ tu grāsaṃ vai parikalpayet
children.translated_text: One should define a morsel as the size of a hen's egg.

children.text: anyathā bhāvadoṣeṇa na dharmo na ca śudhyati ||
children.translated_text: Otherwise, through fault in intention, there is neither <s>dharma</s> nor purification.

children.text: prāyaścitte tataś cīrṇe kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam
children.translated_text: Then, when the expiation has been performed, he should arrange a meal for brahmins.

children.text: godvayaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām ||
children.translated_text: He should give two cows and a pair of garments as a fee to brahmins.

children.text: caṇḍālīṃ vā śvapākīṃ vā hyabhigacchati yo dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: If a twice-born man has intercourse with a <s>Caṇḍālī</s> or a <s>Śvapākī</s>,

children.text: trirātram upavāsitvā viprāṇām anuśāsanam ||
children.translated_text: after fasting for three nights, under the instruction of brahmins,

children.text: saśikhaṃ pavanaṃ kṛtvā prājāpatyadvayaṃ caret
children.translated_text: having made himself pure while retaining the topknot, he should perform two <s>prājāpatya</s> penances.

children.text: godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchuddhiṃ pārāśaro 'bravīt ||
children.translated_text: He should give two cows as the fee; <s>Parāśara</s> declared this purification.

children.text: kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā caṇḍālīṃ gacchato yadi
children.translated_text: If a kṣatriya or a vaiśya goes to a <s>Caṇḍālī</s>,

children.text: prājāpatyadvayaṃ kuryād dadyād gomithunadvayam ||
children.translated_text: he should perform two <s>prājāpatya</s> penances and give two pairs of cows.

children.text: śvapākīṃ vātha caṇḍālīṃ śūdro vā yadi gacchati
children.translated_text: Or if a <s>śūdra</s> goes to a woman of the <s>śvapāka</s> caste or to a <s>caṇḍāla</s> woman,

children.text: prājāpatyaṃ caret kṛcchraṃ caturgomithunaṃ dadet ||
children.translated_text: he should perform the <s>prājāpatya</s> <s>kṛcchra</s> (expiatory austerity) and give four pairs of cows.

children.text: mātaraṃ yadi gacchet tu bhaginīṃ svasutāṃ tathā
children.translated_text: But if he goes to his mother, his sister, or likewise his own daughter,

children.text: etās tu mohito gatvā trīṇi kṛcchrāṇi saṃcaret ||
children.translated_text: having gone to these while deluded, he should perform three <s>kṛcchra</s> austerities.

children.text: cāndrāyaṇatrayaṃ kuryācchiśnachedena śudhyati
children.translated_text: He should perform three <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> vows; he is purified by cutting off the penis.

children.text: mātṛṣvasṛgame caivam ātmameḍhranikartanam ||
children.translated_text: So too, in going to his maternal aunt, there is the cutting off of his own member.

children.text: ajñānena tu yo gacchet kuryāc cāndrāyaṇadvayam
children.translated_text: But one who goes in ignorance should perform two <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> vows.

children.text: daśa gomithunaṃ dadyācchuddhiṃ pārāśaro 'bravīt ||
children.translated_text: He should give ten pairs of cows; <s>Parāśara</s> declared this purification.

children.text: pitṛdārān samāruhya mātur āptāṃ tu bhrātṛjām
children.translated_text: Having mounted his father's wife, or one connected with his mother, or his brother's daughter,

children.text: gurupatnīṃ snuṣāṃ caiva bhrātṛbhāryāṃ tathaiva ca ||
children.translated_text: or his teacher's wife, his daughter-in-law, and likewise his brother's wife,

children.text: mātulānīṃ sagotrāṃ ca prājāpatyatrayaṃ caret
children.translated_text: or his maternal uncle's wife or a woman of the same <s>gotra</s>, he should perform three <s>prājāpatya</s> vows.

children.text: godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He should give two cows as the fee; he is purified, of this there is no doubt.

children.text: paśuveśyādigamane mahiṣyuṣṭrīkapīs tathā
children.translated_text: In going to animals, prostitutes, and the like, and likewise to a buffalo-cow, a she-camel, a female monkey,

children.text: kharīṃ ca sūkarīṃ gatvā prājāpatyavrataṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: a she-ass, or a sow, he should perform the <s>prājāpatya</s> vow.

children.text: gogāmī ca trirātreṇa gām ekāṃ brāhmaṇe dadan
children.translated_text: One who goes to a cow is purified in three nights, giving one cow to a brahmin.

children.text: mahiṣyuṣṭrīkharīgāmī tvahorātreṇa śudhyati ||
children.translated_text: But one who goes to a buffalo-cow, she-camel, or she-ass is purified in a day and night.

children.text: ḍāmare samare vāpi durbhikṣe vā janakṣaye
children.translated_text: In a tumult, in battle, in famine, or when people are being destroyed,

children.text: bandigrāhe bhayārtā vā sadā svastrīṃ nirīkṣayet ||
children.translated_text: or when captives are seized, a woman afflicted by fear should always look to her own husband.

children.text: caṇḍālaiḥ saha saṃparkaṃ yā nārī kurute tataḥ
children.translated_text: A woman who then has contact with <s>caṇḍālas</s>

children.text: viprān daśa varān kṛtvā svakaṃ doṣaṃ prakāśayet ||
children.translated_text: should choose ten excellent brahmins and disclose her own fault.

children.text: ākaṇṭhasaṃmite kūpe gomayodakakardame
children.translated_text: In a pit reaching up to the throat, filled with cow-dung, water, and mud,

children.text: tatra sthitvā nirāhārā tvahorātreṇa niṣkramet ||
children.translated_text: she should stand there without food and come out after a day and night.

children.text: saśikhaṃ vapanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīyād yāvakaudanam
children.translated_text: Having shaved the head together with the topknot, she should eat barley-rice.

children.text: trirātram upavāsitvā tvekarātraṃ jale vaset ||
children.translated_text: Having fasted for three nights, she should stay in water for one night.

children.text: śaṃkhapuṣpīlatāmūlaṃ patraṃ vā kusumaṃ phalam
children.translated_text: The root, leaf, flower, or fruit of the <s>śaṃkhapuṣpī</s> creeper,

children.text: suvarṇaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca kvāthayitvā pibejjalam ||
children.translated_text: together with gold and the five cow-products, should be boiled, and she should drink the water.

children.text: ekabhaktaṃ caret paścād yāvat puṣpavatī bhavet
children.translated_text: Afterwards she should observe taking one meal a day until she becomes menstruant.

children.text: vrataṃ carati tad yāvat tāvat saṃvasate bahiḥ ||
children.translated_text: For as long as she observes that vow, for that long she lives outside.

children.text: prāyaścitte tataś cīrṇe kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam
children.translated_text: Then, when the expiation has been performed, she should arrange a feeding of brahmins.

children.text: godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchuddhiṃ pārāśaro 'bravīt ||
children.translated_text: She should give two cows as the fee; <s>Parāśara</s> declared this purification.

children.text: cāturvarṇyasya nārīṇāṃ kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam
children.translated_text: For women of the four social classes, the vow is a <s>kṛcchra</s> and a <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: yathā bhūmis tathā nārī tasmāt tāṃ na tu dūṣayet ||
children.translated_text: As the earth is, so is a woman; therefore one should not condemn her.

children.text: bandigrāheṇa yā bhuktā hatvā baddhvā balād bhayāt
children.translated_text: A woman who has been used by a captor, after being struck, bound, or forced through fear,

children.text: kṛtvā sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ śudhyet pārāśaro 'bravīt ||
children.translated_text: is purified by performing the <s>sāṃtapana</s> <s>kṛcchra</s>; so <s>Parāśara</s> declared.

children.text: sakṛd bhuktā tu yā nārī necchantī pāpakarmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: But a woman who has been used once by sinful men while unwilling

children.text: prājāpatyena śudhyeta ṛtuprasravaṇena ca ||
children.translated_text: is purified by the <s>prājāpatya</s> and also by the flow of her menstrual period.

children.text: pataty ardhaṃ śarīrasya yasya bhāryā surāṃ pibet
children.translated_text: Half the body of a man whose wife drinks liquor falls.

children.text: patitārdhaśarīrasya niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: For one whose half body has fallen, no expiation is prescribed.

children.text: gāyatrīṃ japamānas tu kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret
children.translated_text: Reciting the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, however, he should perform the <s>sāṃtapana</s> <s>kṛcchra</s>.

children.text: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam ||
children.translated_text: Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curds, ghee, and water with <s>kuśa</s> grass,

children.text: ekarātropavāsaś ca kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam
children.translated_text: together with fasting for one night, are remembered as the <s>sāṃtapana</s> <s>kṛcchra</s>.

children.text: jāreṇa janayed garbhaṃ mṛte 'vyakte gate patau ||
children.translated_text: If she conceives a fetus by a lover when her husband is dead, missing, or gone away,

children.text: tāṃ tyajed apare rāṣṭre patitāṃ pāpakāriṇīm
children.translated_text: one should abandon that fallen sinful woman in another kingdom.

children.text: brāhmaṇī tu yadā gacchet parapuṃsā samanvitā ||
children.translated_text: But when a brahmin woman goes off together with another man,

children.text: sā tu naṣṭā vinirdiṣṭā na tasyāgamanaṃ punaḥ
children.translated_text: she is declared lost; there is no return for her.

children.text: kāmān mohāt tu yā gacchet tyaktvā bandhūn sutān patim ||
children.translated_text: A woman who goes off out of desire or delusion, abandoning relatives, sons, and husband,

children.text: sā tu naṣṭā pare loke mānuṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ
children.translated_text: is lost in the next world, and especially among human beings.

children.text: madamohagatā nārī krodhād daṇḍāditāḍitā ||
children.translated_text: A woman gone through intoxication or delusion, or struck with punishment and the like out of anger,

children.text: advitīyā gatā caiva punarāgamanaṃ bhavet
children.translated_text: and gone without a companion, may return.

children.text: daśame tu dine prāpte prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: But when the tenth day has arrived, there is no expiation.

children.text: daśāhaṃ na tyajen nārīṃ tyajen naṣṭaśrutāṃ tathā
children.translated_text: One should not abandon a woman for ten days, but one should abandon her if she is heard to be lost.

children.text: bhartā caiva caret kṛcchraṃ kṛcchrārdhaṃ caiva bāndhavāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The husband himself should perform a <s>kṛcchra</s>, and the relatives half a <s>kṛcchra</s>.

children.text: teṣāṃ bhuktvā ca pītvā ca ahorātreṇa śudhyati
children.translated_text: Having eaten and drunk from them, one is purified in a day and night.

children.text: brāhmaṇī tu yadā gacchet parapuṃsā vivarjitā ||
children.translated_text: But when a brahmin woman goes without being separated from another man,

children.text: gatvā puṃsāṃ śataṃ yāti tyajeyustāṃ tu gotriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: having gone to a hundred men, her kinsmen should abandon her.

children.text: puṃso yadi gṛhe gacchet tad aśuddhaṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: If she goes into a man's house, that house becomes impure.

children.text: patimātṛgṛhaṃ yac ca jārasyaiva tu tad gṛham
children.translated_text: The husband's mother's house and the lover's own house are such houses.

children.text: ullikhya tad gṛhaṃ paścāt pañcagavyena secayet ||
children.translated_text: After scraping that house, one should sprinkle it with the five cow-products.

children.text: tyajecca mṛṇmayaṃ pātraṃ vastraṃ kāṣṭhaṃ ca śodhayet
children.translated_text: One should discard earthen vessels, and purify cloth and wood.

children.text: saṃbhārān śodhayet sarvān gobālaiś ca phalodbhavān ||
children.translated_text: One should purify all provisions, and those produced from fruits with cow-hair.

children.text: tāmrāṇi pañcagavyena kāṃsyāni daśa bhasmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Copper vessels are purified with the five cow-products, bronze vessels with ten applications of ashes.

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ cared vipro brāhmaṇair upapāditam ||
children.translated_text: A brahmin should perform the expiation prescribed by brahmins.

children.text: godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt prājāpatyadvayaṃ caret
children.translated_text: He should give two cows as the fee and perform two <s>prājāpatya</s> vows.

children.text: itareṣām ahorātraṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca śodhanam ||
children.translated_text: For others, a day and night and the five cow-products are the purification.

children.text: upavāsair vrataiḥ puṇyaiḥ snānasaṃdhyārcanādibhiḥ
children.translated_text: By fasts, vows, meritorious acts, bathing, twilight worship, and rites of honor,

children.text: japahomadayādānaiḥ śudhyante brāhmaṇādayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and by recitation, oblation, compassion, and gifts, brahmins and the others are purified.

children.text: ākāśaṃ vāyur agniś ca medhyaṃ bhūmigataṃ jalam
children.translated_text: Space, wind, fire, and water situated in the earth are pure,

children.text: na praduṣyanti darbhāś ca yajñeṣu camasā yathā ||
children.translated_text: and darbha grasses are not defiled in sacrifices, just as the cups are not.

children.text: Chapter 11
amedhyareto gomāṃsaṃ caṇḍālānnam athāpi vā
children.translated_text: If semen that is impure, cow flesh, or food of <s>caṇḍālas</s>

children.text: yadi bhuktaṃ tu vipreṇa kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: has been eaten by a brahmin, he should perform a <s>kṛcchra</s> and a <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: tathaiva kṣatriyo vaiśyo 'pyardhaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
children.translated_text: Likewise a kṣatriya and a vaiśya should perform half a <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: śūdro 'pyevaṃ yadā bhuṅkte prājāpatyaṃ samācaret ||
children.translated_text: When a <s>śūdra</s> too eats in this way, he should perform a <s>prājāpatya</s>.

children.text: pañcagavyaṃ pibecchūdro brahmakūrcaṃ pibed dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: A <s>śūdra</s> should drink the five cow-products; a twice-born man should drink the <s>brahmakūrca</s>.

children.text: ekadvitricatur gā vā dadyād viprādyanukramāt ||
children.translated_text: One, two, three, or four cows should be given in sequence, beginning with the brahmin.

children.text: śūdrānnaṃ sūtakānnaṃ ca abhojyasyānnam eva ca
children.translated_text: Food from a <s>Śūdra</s>, food connected with birth impurity, and the food of one whose food must not be eaten,

children.text: śaṅkitaṃ pratiṣiddhānnaṃ pūrvocchiṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca ||
children.translated_text: food that is suspect, forbidden food, and likewise food left over from a previous meal:

children.text: yadi bhuktaṃ tu vipreṇa ajñānād āpadāpi vā
children.translated_text: if it has been eaten by a brahmin through ignorance or even in distress,

children.text: jñātvā samācaret kṛcchraṃ brahmakūrcaṃ tu pāvanam ||
children.translated_text: on learning of it he should perform a <s>kṛcchra</s>; but <s>brahmakūrca</s> is purifying.

children.text: bālair nakulamārjārair annam ucchiṣṭitaṃ yadā
children.translated_text: When food has been made leftover by children, a mongoose, or cats,

children.text: tiladarbhodakaiḥ prokṣya śudhyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: it becomes pure when sprinkled with sesame, darbha grass, and water; there is no doubt about this.

children.text: ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭānāṃ viprāṇāṃ saha bhojane
children.translated_text: When brahmins seated in one row are eating together,

children.text: yady eko 'pi tyajet pātraṃ śeṣam annaṃ na bhojayet ||
children.translated_text: if even one of them sets down his vessel, the remaining food should not be eaten.

children.text: mohād bhuñjīta yas tatra paṅktāvucchiṣṭabhojane
children.translated_text: If, through delusion, a brahmin eats there in the row, eating what has become leftover,

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ cared vipraḥ kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ tathā ||
children.translated_text: he should perform an expiation, namely the <s>kṛcchra</s> and also the <s>sāṃtapana</s>.

children.text: pīyūṣaṃ śvetalaśunaṃ vṛntākaphalagṛñjane
children.translated_text: Colostrum, white garlic, eggplant fruit, green garlic,

children.text: palāṇḍuvṛkṣaniryāsadevasvakavakāni ca ||
children.translated_text: onions, tree exudations, property of the gods, and mushrooms:

children.text: uṣṭrīkṣīram avikṣīram ajñānād bhuñjate dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: if a twice-born man eats camel milk or sheep milk through ignorance,

children.text: trirātram upavāsena pañcagavyena śudhyati ||
children.translated_text: he is purified by fasting for three nights and by <s>pañcagavya</s>.

children.text: maṇḍūkaṃ bhakṣayitvā tu mūṣikāmāṃsam eva ca
children.translated_text: But after eating a frog or the flesh of a mouse,

children.text: jñātvā vipras tv ahorātraṃ yāvakānnena śudhyati ||
children.translated_text: a brahmin, on realizing it, is purified by eating barley food for a day and night.

children.text: kṣatriyaś cāpi vaiśyaś ca kriyāvantau śucivratau
children.translated_text: A <s>Kṣatriya</s> and also a <s>Vaiśya</s> who perform rites and observe pure vows:

children.text: tadgṛhe tu dvijair bhojyaṃ havyakavyeṣu nityaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in their house food may always be eaten by twice-born men in rites for gods and ancestors.

children.text: ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ bhakṣyaṃ snehena pācitam
children.translated_text: Ghee, oil, milk, and food cooked with fat:

children.text: gatvā nadītaṭe vipro bhuñjīyācchūdrabhojanam ||
children.translated_text: a brahmin may go to a river bank and eat food from a <s>Śūdra</s>.

children.text: madyamāṃsarataṃ nityaṃ nīcakarmapravartakam
children.translated_text: A <s>Śūdra</s> who is always devoted to liquor and meat and engaged in base actions:

children.text: taṃ śūdraṃ varjayed vipraḥ śvapākam iva dūrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: a brahmin should avoid him from afar, like a <s>Śvapāka</s>.

children.text: dvijaśuśrūṣaṇaratān madyamāṃsavivarjitān
children.translated_text: But <s>Śūdras</s> devoted to serving the twice-born, abstaining from liquor and meat,

children.text: svakarmaṇi ratān nityaṃ na tān śūdrān tyajed dvijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and always intent on their own work: a twice-born man should not reject them.

children.text: ajñānād bhuñjate viprāḥ sūtake mṛtake 'pi vā
children.translated_text: If brahmins through ignorance eat during birth impurity, or even during death impurity,

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ varṇe varṇe vinirdiśet ||
children.translated_text: how should expiation for them be prescribed, according to each varṇa?

children.text: gāyatryaṣṭasahasreṇa śuddhiḥ syācchūdrasūtake
children.translated_text: Purification from a <s>Śūdra</s> birth impurity comes by eight thousand recitations of the <s>Gāyatrī</s>;

children.text: vaiśye pañcasahasreṇa trisahasreṇa kṣatriye ||
children.translated_text: for a <s>Vaiśya</s>, by five thousand; for a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, by three thousand.

children.text: brāhmaṇasya yadā bhuṅkte dve sahasre tu dāpayet
children.translated_text: When he eats in the case of a brahmin, he should be made to give two thousand,

children.text: athavā vāmadaivyena sāmnaivaikena śudhyati ||
children.translated_text: or else he is purified by the single <s>Vāmadevya</s> <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: śuṣkānnaṃ gorasaṃ snehaṃ śūdraveśmana āgatam
children.translated_text: Dry food, cow products, and fat that have come from a <s>Śūdra</s> house,

children.text: pakvaṃ vipragṛhe bhuktaṃ bhojyaṃ tan manur abravīt ||
children.translated_text: when cooked in a brahmin house, may be eaten; so <s>Manu</s> said.

children.text: āpatkāleṣu vipreṇa bhuktaṃ śūdragṛhe yadi
children.translated_text: If in times of distress a brahmin has eaten in a <s>Śūdra</s> house,

children.text: manastāpena śudhyeta drupadāṃ vā japecchatam ||
children.translated_text: he may be purified by remorse, or he should recite the <s>Drupadā</s> a hundred times.

children.text: dāsanāpitagopālakulamitrārdhasīliṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Slaves, barbers, cowherds, family friends, and sharecroppers:

children.text: ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā yaś cātmānaṃ nivedayet ||
children.translated_text: these are those among <s>Śūdras</s> whose food may be eaten, and also one who offers himself in service.

children.text: śūdrakanyāsamutpanno brāhmaṇena tu saṃskṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: One born from a <s>Śūdra</s> girl and consecrated by a brahmin:

children.text: saṃskārāt tu bhaved dāsaḥ asaṃskārāt tu nāpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: through consecration he becomes a slave; without consecration, a barber.

children.text: kṣatriyācchūdrakanyāyāṃ samutpannas tu yaḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The son born from a <s>Śūdra</s> girl by a <s>Kṣatriya</s>:

children.text: sa gopāla iti jñeyo bhojyo viprair na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he should be known as a cowherd, and his food may be eaten by brahmins; there is no doubt.

children.text: vaiśyakanyāsamutpanno brāhmaṇena tu saṃskṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: One born from a <s>Vaiśya</s> girl and consecrated by a brahmin:

children.text: sa hy ārdhika iti jñeyo bhojyo viprair na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he should be known as an <s>ārdhika</s> (sharecropper), and his food may be eaten by brahmins; there is no doubt.

children.text: bhāṇḍasthitam abhojyeṣu jalaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ
children.translated_text: Water, curd, ghee, and milk kept in a vessel among things not fit to be eaten:

children.text: akāmatas tu yo bhuṅkte prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: if someone eats them unintentionally, what should the expiation be?

children.text: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā upasarpati
children.translated_text: A brahmin, <s>Kṣatriya</s>, <s>Vaiśya</s>, or <s>Śūdra</s> may approach;

children.text: brahmakūrcopavāsena yājyavarṇasya niṣkṛtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: for a varṇa entitled to sacrifice, the atonement is <s>brahmakūrca</s> and fasting.

children.text: śūdrāṇāṃ nopavāsaḥ syācchūdro dānena śudhyati
children.translated_text: For <s>Śūdras</s> there should be no fasting; a <s>Śūdra</s> is purified by giving.

children.text: brahmakūrcam ahorātraṃ śvapākam api śodhayet ||
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmakūrca</s> with a day-and-night fast purifies even a <s>Śvapāka</s>.

children.text: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam
children.translated_text: Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, ghee, and water with kuśa grass:

children.text: nirdiṣṭaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tu pavitraṃ pāpaśodhanam ||
children.translated_text: this is prescribed as <s>pañcagavya</s>, purifying and cleansing sin.

children.text: gomūtraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāś caiva gomayam
children.translated_text: The cow urine is from a black cow, and the cow dung from a white one;

children.text: payaś ca tāmravarṇāyā raktāyā gṛhyate dadhi ||
children.translated_text: the milk is taken from a copper-colored cow, and the curd from a red one.

children.text: kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvaṃ kāpilam eva vā
children.translated_text: The ghee should be taken from a tawny cow, or else all may be from a tawny cow.

children.text: mūtram ekapalaṃ dadyād aṅguṣṭhārdhaṃ tu gomayam ||
children.translated_text: One should put in one pala of urine and half a thumb-measure of cow dung.

children.text: kṣīraṃ saptapalaṃ dadyād dadhi tripalam ucyate
children.translated_text: One should put in seven palas of milk; the curd is said to be three palas.

children.text: ghṛtam ekapalaṃ dadyāt palam ekaṃ kuśodakam ||
children.translated_text: One should put in one pala of ghee and one pala of kuśa-water.

children.text: gāyatryādāya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam
children.translated_text: Taking the cow urine with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, and the cow dung with “gandhadvāra,”

children.text: āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇas tathā dadhi ||
children.translated_text: the milk with “āpyāyasva,” and the curd likewise with “dadhikrāvṇas,”

children.text: tejo 'si śukram ity ājyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam
children.translated_text: the ghee with “tejo asi śukram,” and the kuśa-water with “devasya tvā,”

children.text: pañcagavyam ṛcā pūtaṃ sthāpayed agnisaṃnidhau ||
children.translated_text: one should place the <s>pañcagavya</s>, purified by the ṛc, near the fire.

children.text: āpohiṣṭheti cāloḍya mānastoketi mantrayet
children.translated_text: Having stirred it with “āpo hi ṣṭhā,” he should consecrate it with “mā nastoke.”

children.text: saptāvarās tu ye darbhā achinnāgrāḥ śukatviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There should be at least seven darbha blades, with uncut tips and bright in color.

children.text: etair uddhṛtya hotavyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ yathāvidhi
children.translated_text: With these he should lift out the <s>pañcagavya</s> and offer it according to rule.

children.text: irāvatī idaṃ viṣṇur mānastoketi śaṃvatī ||
children.translated_text: With “irāvatī,” “idaṃ viṣṇuḥ,” “mā nastoke,” and “śaṃvatī,”

children.text: etābhiś caiva hotavyaṃ hutaśeṣaṃ pibed dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: with these too it should be offered; the twice-born man should drink what remains from the oblation.

children.text: āloḍya praṇavenaiva nirmanthya praṇavena tu ||
children.translated_text: He should stir it with the <s>praṇava</s> alone, and churn it with the <s>praṇava</s>;

children.text: uddhṛtya praṇavenaiva pibecca praṇavena tu
children.translated_text: he should lift it out with the <s>praṇava</s> alone, and drink it with the <s>praṇava</s>.

children.text: yat tv asthigataṃ pāpaṃ dehe tiṣṭhati dehinām ||
children.translated_text: Whatever sin remains lodged in the bones in the bodies of embodied beings,

children.text: brahmakūrco dahet sarvaṃ pradīptāgnir ivendhanam
children.translated_text: <s>brahmakūrca</s> burns all of it, like a blazing fire burning fuel.

children.text: pavitraṃ triṣu lokeṣu devatābhir adhiṣṭhitam ||
children.translated_text: It is holy in the three worlds and is presided over by deities.

children.text: varuṇaś caiva gomūtre gomaye havyavāhanaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> is in the cow urine, and the oblation-bearer fire is in the cow dung;

children.text: dadhni vāyuḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ somaḥ kṣīre ghṛte raviḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> is declared to be in the curd, <s>Soma</s> in the milk, and the sun in the ghee.

children.text: pibataḥ patitaṃ toyaṃ bhājane mukhaniḥsṛtam
children.translated_text: Water that falls from someone drinking, issued from the mouth into a vessel,

children.text: apeyaṃ tad vijānīyāt pītvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: one should know that to be undrinkable; after drinking it, one should perform the <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: kūpe ca patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śvasṛgālau ca markaṭam
