children.translated_text: And when one sees that a dog, a jackal, or a monkey has fallen into a well,

children.text: asthicarmādi patitaṃ pītvāmedhyā apo dvijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A twice-born man who has drunk water polluted by fallen bones, skin, and the like, or by impure things,

children.text: nāraṃ tu kuṇapaṃ kākaṃ viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrakam
children.translated_text: or by a human corpse, a dead body, a crow, a village pig, a donkey, or a camel,

children.text: gāvayaṃ saupratīkaṃ ca māyūraṃ khāḍgakaṃ tathā ||
children.translated_text: or by a wild ox, an elephant, a peacock, and likewise a rhinoceros,

children.text: vaiyāghram ārkṣaṃ saiṃhaṃ vā kūpe yadi nimajjati
children.translated_text: or by a tiger, bear, or lion, if any of these sinks into a well,

children.text: taṭākasyātha duṣṭasya pītaṃ syād udakaṃ yadi ||
children.translated_text: or if water is drunk from a tank that has thus been defiled,

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ bhavet puṃsaḥ krameṇaitena sarvaśaḥ
children.translated_text: for a man there should be expiation, in every case, according to this sequence:

children.text: vipraḥ śudhyet trirātreṇa kṣatriyas tu dinadvayāt ||
children.translated_text: a brahmin is purified in three nights, but a <s>Kṣatriya</s> in two days;

children.text: ekāhena tu vaiśyas tu śūdro naktena śudhyati
children.translated_text: a <s>Vaiśya</s> is purified in one day, and a <s>Śūdra</s> by a night-fast.

children.text: parapākanivṛttasya parapākaratasya ca ||
children.translated_text: For one who has abandoned cooking for others, and for one who is devoted to cooking for others,

children.text: apacasya ca bhuktvānnaṃ dvijaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
children.translated_text: and after eating the food of an <s>apaca</s> (outcaste cook), a twice-born man should perform the <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>.

children.text: apacasya ca yad dānaṃ dātuś cāsya kutaḥ phalam ||
children.translated_text: And as for a gift from an <s>apaca</s>, whence can there be any fruit for its giver?

children.text: dātā pratigrahītā ca tau dvau nirayagāminau
children.translated_text: The giver and the receiver: those two go to hell.

children.text: gṛhītvāgniṃ samāropya pañcayajñān na nirvapet ||
children.translated_text: Having taken up the sacred fire and installed it, if he does not perform the five sacrifices,

children.text: parapākanivṛtto 'sau munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ
children.translated_text: he is called by the sages one who has abandoned cooking for others.

children.text: pañcayajñān svayaṃ kṛtvā parānnenopajīvati ||
children.translated_text: Having himself performed the five sacrifices, if he lives on another's food,

children.text: satataṃ prātar utthāya parapākaratas tu saḥ
children.translated_text: constantly, rising in the morning, he is one devoted to another's cooking.

children.text: gṛhasthadharmā yo vipro dadāti parivarjitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The brahmin who gives while devoid of the dharma of a householder

children.text: ṛṣibhir dharmatattvajñair apacaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
children.translated_text: is called an <s>apaca</s> by the seers who know the truth of <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: yuge yuge tu ye dharmās teṣu teṣu ca ye dvijāḥ ||
children.translated_text: In each age there are particular dharmas, and in each of those ages there are particular twice-born men.

children.text: teṣāṃ nindā na kartavyā yugarūpā hi te dvijāḥ
children.translated_text: They should not be censured, for those twice-born men conform to the nature of their age.

children.text: huṃkāraṃ brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṃkāraṃ ca garīyasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having uttered a contemptuous “huṃ” to a brahmin, or addressed a superior as “you,”

children.text: snātvā tiṣṭhann ahaḥ śeṣam abhivādya prasādayet
children.translated_text: one should bathe, remain standing for the rest of the day, salute him, and appease him.

children.text: tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi kaṇṭhe baddhvāpi vāsasā ||
children.translated_text: Having struck him even with a blade of grass, or having bound his neck even with a garment,

children.text: vivādenāpi nirjitya praṇipatya prasādayet
children.translated_text: or having defeated him even in a dispute, one should bow down and appease him.

children.text: avagūrya tv ahorātraṃ trirātraṃ kṣitipātane ||
children.translated_text: For raising a weapon against him, there is a day and night; for knocking him to the ground, three nights;

children.text: atikṛcchraṃ ca rudhire kṛcchro 'bhyantaraśoṇite
children.translated_text: for bloodshed, the <s>atikṛcchra</s>; for internal bleeding, the <s>kṛcchra</s>.

children.text: navāham atikṛcchrī syāt pāṇipūrānnabhojanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>atikṛcchra</s> lasts nine days, with food only as much as fills the hands;

children.text: trirātram upavāsī syād atikṛcchraḥ sa ucyate
children.translated_text: for three nights one should fast: this is called the <s>atikṛcchra</s>.

children.text: sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ saṃkare samupasthite ||
children.translated_text: When a mixture of all sins has arisen,

children.text: daśasāhasram abhyastā gāyatrī śodhanaṃ paraṃ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, repeated ten thousand times, is the supreme purifier.

children.text: Chapter 12
duḥsvapnaṃ yadi paśyet tu vānte tu kṣurakarmaṇi
children.translated_text: If one sees a bad dream, or after vomiting, or after shaving,

children.text: maithune pretadhūme ca snānam eva vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: or after sexual intercourse, or contact with smoke from a corpse, bathing alone is prescribed.

children.text: ajñānāt prāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭam eva ca
children.translated_text: Having unknowingly eaten feces or urine, or anything touched by liquor,

children.text: punaḥ saṃskāram arhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the three twice-born varṇas deserve consecration again.

children.text: ajinaṃ mekhalā daṇḍo bhaikṣyacaryā vratāni ca
children.translated_text: The antelope skin, girdle, staff, begging round, and vows

children.text: nivartante dvijātīnāṃ punaḥ saṃskārakarmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: are repeated for twice-born men in the rite of re-consecration.

children.text: viṇmūtrabhojī śuddhyarthaṃ prājāpatyaṃ samācaret
children.translated_text: One who has eaten feces or urine should perform the <s>prājāpatya</s> for purification.

children.text: pañcagavyaṃ ca kurvīta snātvā pītvā śucir bhavet ||
children.translated_text: He should also perform the <s>pañcagavya</s>; having bathed and drunk it, he becomes pure.

children.text: jalāgnipatane caiva pravrajyānāśakeṣu ca
children.translated_text: In cases of falling into water or fire, and for those whose renunciation has failed,

children.text: pratyavasitavarṇānāṃ kathaṃ śuddhir vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: and for those who have fallen back from their varṇa, how is purification prescribed?

children.text: prājāpatyadvayenaiva tīrthābhigamanena ca
children.translated_text: By two <s>prājāpatya</s> rites and by going to sacred fords,

children.text: vṛṣaikādaśadānena varṇāḥ śudhyanti te trayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and by giving eleven bulls, those three varṇas are purified.

children.text: brāhmaṇasya pravakṣyāmi vanaṃ gatvā catuṣpathe
children.translated_text: For a brahmin I shall explain: having gone to a forest or a crossroads,

children.text: saśikhaṃ vapanaṃ kṛtvā prājāpatyadvayaṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: he should shave his head together with the topknot and perform two <s>prājāpatya</s> rites.

children.text: godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchuddhiṃ svāyaṃbhuvo 'bravīt
children.translated_text: He should give two cows as the fee; <s>Svāyambhuva</s> declared this purification.

children.text: mucyate tena pāpena brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca gacchati ||
children.translated_text: By that he is freed from the sin and attains brahminhood.

children.text: snānāni pañca puṇyāni kīrtitāni manīṣibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Five holy baths have been taught by the wise:

children.text: āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ brāhmaṃ vāyavyaṃ divyam eva ca ||
children.translated_text: the fiery, the watery, the brahmanic, the airy, and the divine.

children.text: āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānam avagāhya tu vāruṇam
children.translated_text: The fiery bath is bathing with ashes; the watery is by immersion.

children.text: āpohiṣṭheti ca brāhmaṃ vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ smṛtam ||
children.translated_text: The brahmanic bath is with the mantra “āpo hi ṣṭhā”; the airy is remembered as dust from cows.

children.text: yat tu sātapavarṣeṇa tat snānaṃ divyam ucyate
children.translated_text: That which is by rain while the sun is shining is called the divine bath.

children.text: tatra snātvā tu gaṅgāyāṃ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By bathing there, in the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, a human being becomes bathed indeed.

children.text: snātuṃ yāntaṃ dvijaṃ sarve devāḥ pitṛgaṇaiḥ saha
children.translated_text: All the gods, together with the hosts of ancestors, go to the twice-born man who is going to bathe.

children.text: vāyubhūtās tu gacchanti tṛṣārtāḥ salilārthinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Becoming wind, they go, thirsty and desiring water.

children.text: nirāśās te nivartante vastraniṣpīḍane kṛte
children.translated_text: They turn back disappointed when the garment has been wrung out.

children.text: tasmān na pīḍayed vastraṃ akṛtvā pitṛtarpaṇam ||
children.translated_text: Therefore one should not wring out the garment before performing tarpaṇa for the ancestors.

children.text: romakūpeṣv avasthāpya yas tilais tarpayet pitṝn
children.translated_text: The man who, placing them in the pores of his hair, satisfies the ancestors with sesame seeds,

children.text: pitaras tarpitās tena rudhireṇa malena ca ||
children.translated_text: by him the ancestors are satisfied with blood and impurity.

children.text: avadhūnoti yaḥ keśān snātvā yas tūtsṛjen malam
children.translated_text: He who shakes out his hair after bathing, or who discharges impurity,

children.text: ācāmed vā jalasthe 'pi sa bāhyaḥ pitṛdaivataiḥ ||
children.translated_text: or who performs ācamana even while standing in water, is excluded from the ancestors and deities.

children.text: śiraḥ prāvṛttya kaṇṭhaṃ vā muktakacchaśikho 'pi vā
children.translated_text: With his head covered, or his neck, or with his lower garment and topknot loosened,

children.text: vinā yajñopavītena ācānto 'py aśucir bhavet ||
children.translated_text: or without the sacred thread, even after ācamana he remains impure.

children.text: jale sthalastho nācāmej jalasthaś ca bahiḥsthale
children.translated_text: Standing on land, one should not sip water from water, nor, standing in water, from dry land.

children.text: ubhe spṛṣṭvā samācānta ubhayatra śucir bhavet ||
children.translated_text: Having touched both and then performed ācamana, one becomes pure in both places.

children.text: snātvā pītvā kṣute supte bhuktvā rathyopasarpaṇe
children.translated_text: After bathing, drinking, sneezing, sleeping, eating, or going along a road,

children.text: ācāntaḥ punar ācāmed vāso viparidhāya ca ||
children.translated_text: one who has performed ācamana should perform ācamana again, and also after changing clothes.

children.text: kṣute niṣṭhīvane caiva dantocchiṣṭe tathānṛte
children.translated_text: On sneezing, spitting, when there is residue from the teeth, and likewise on speaking falsehood,

children.text: patitānāṃ ca saṃbhāṣe dakṣiṇaṃ śravaṇaṃ spṛśet ||
children.translated_text: and in conversation with fallen persons, one should touch the right ear.

children.text: prabhāsādīni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā
children.translated_text: The sacred fords such as <s>Prabhāsa</s>, and the rivers such as <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: viprasya dakṣiṇe karṇe santīti manur abravīt ||
children.translated_text: are in a brahmin's right ear: so <s>Manu</s> said.

children.text: agnir āpaś ca vedāś ca somasūryānilās tathā
children.translated_text: Fire, the waters, the Vedas, and also <s>Soma</s>, the sun, and wind,

children.text: sarva eva tu viprasya śrotre tiṣṭhanti dakṣiṇe ||
children.translated_text: all of them dwell in a brahmin's right ear.

children.text: bhāskarasya karaiḥ pūtaṃ divā snānaṃ praśasyate
children.translated_text: Bathing by day, purified by the rays of the sun, is praised.

children.text: apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhor anyatra darśanāt ||
children.translated_text: Bathing at night is not praised, except on seeing <s>Rāhu</s>.

children.text: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ kartavyo rāhudarśane
children.translated_text: When <s>Rāhu</s> is seen, bathing, giving, recitation, and oblation should be performed.

children.text: anyadā tv aśucī rātris tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet ||
children.translated_text: But at another time the night is impure; therefore one should avoid it.

children.text: maruto vasavo rudrā ādityāś caiva devatāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s>, the <s>Vasus</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, and the <s>Ādityas</s> are indeed deities;

children.text: sarve some pralīyante tasmād dānaṃ tu tadgrahe ||
children.translated_text: all are dissolved in <s>Soma</s>; therefore there should be a gift at that eclipse.

children.text: khalayajñe vivāhe ca saṃkrāntau grahaṇe tathā
children.translated_text: At a threshing-floor sacrifice, at a wedding, at a solar transition, and likewise at an eclipse,

children.text: śarvaryāṃ dānam asty eva nānyatraiva vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: there is indeed giving at night; it is prescribed nowhere else.

children.text: putrajanmani yajñe ca tathā cātyayakarmaṇi
children.translated_text: At the birth of a son, at a sacrifice, and likewise in an emergency rite,

children.text: rāhoś ca darśane dānaṃ praśastaṃ nānyadā niśi ||
children.translated_text: and at the sight of <s>Rāhu</s>, giving is praised; at no other time at night.

children.text: mahāniśā tu vijñeyā madhyasthaṃ praharadvayam
children.translated_text: The great night should be understood as the two middle watches;

children.text: pradoṣapaścimau yāmau dinavat snānam ācaret ||
children.translated_text: during the watches at twilight and at the end of night one should bathe as by day.

children.text: caityavṛkṣaś citir yūpaś caṇḍālaḥ somavikrayī
children.translated_text: A caitya tree, a funeral pyre, a sacrificial post, a <s>Caṇḍāla</s>, and a seller of <s>Soma</s>:

children.text: etāṃs tu brāhmaṇaḥ spṛṣṭvā savāsā jalam āviśet ||
children.translated_text: having touched these, a brahmin should enter water with his clothes on.

children.text: asthisaṃcayanāt pūrvaṃ ruditvā snānam ācaret
children.translated_text: Before the gathering of bones, after weeping, one should bathe;

children.text: antardaśāhe viprasya hy ūrdhvam ācamanaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: within ten days for a brahmin, but afterward sipping water is sufficient.

children.text: sarvaṃ gaṅgāsamaṃ toyaṃ rāhugraste divākare
children.translated_text: All water is equal to the <s>Gaṅgā</s> when the sun is seized by <s>Rāhu</s>;

children.text: somagrahe tathaivoktaṃ snānadānādikarmasu ||
children.translated_text: the same is said at a lunar eclipse for rites such as bathing and giving.

children.text: kuśaiḥ pūtaṃ tu yat snānaṃ kuśenopaspṛśed dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: A bath purified with kuśa grass: the twice-born man should touch water with kuśa;

children.text: kuśena coddhṛtaṃ toyaṃ somapānasamaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: water lifted out with kuśa becomes equal to drinking <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: agnikāryāt paribhraṣṭāḥ saṃdhyopāsanavarjitāḥ
children.translated_text: Those who have fallen away from the fire rite, who are without twilight worship,

children.text: vedaṃ caivānadhīyānāḥ sarve te vṛṣalāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and who do not study the <s>Veda</s>: all of them are remembered as <s>vṛṣalas</s> (outcast-like men).

children.text: tasmād vṛṣalabhītena brāhmaṇena viśeṣataḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore, especially by a brahmin who fears becoming a <s>vṛṣala</s>,

children.text: adhyetavyo 'py ekadeśo yadi sarvaṃ na śakyate ||
children.translated_text: even one portion should be studied if the whole cannot be done.

children.text: śūdrānnarasapuṣṭasyāpy adhīyānasya nityaśaḥ
children.translated_text: For one who is nourished by the essence of <s>Śūdra</s> food, even if he studies constantly,

children.text: japato juhvato vāpi gatir ūrdhvā na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: whether reciting or offering oblations, there is no upward course.

children.text: śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaḥ śūdreṇa tu sahāsanam
children.translated_text: <s>Śūdra</s> food, contact with a <s>Śūdra</s>, sitting together with a <s>Śūdra</s>,

children.text: śūdrāj jñānāgamaś caiva jvalantam api pātayet ||
children.translated_text: and receiving knowledge from a <s>Śūdra</s> will cast down even one who is blazing.

children.text: yaḥ śūdryā pācayen nityaṃ śūdrī ca gṛhamedhinī
children.translated_text: The twice-born man who regularly has a <s>Śūdra</s> woman cook, and whose housewife is a <s>Śūdra</s> woman,

children.text: varjitaḥ pitṛdevebhyo rauravaṃ yāti sa dvijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: excluded from the ancestors and the gods, goes to <s>Raurava</s>.

children.text: mṛtasūtakapuṣṭāṅgo dvijaḥ śūdrānnabhojanaḥ
children.translated_text: A twice-born man whose body is nourished by food from death or birth impurity, or who eats <s>Śūdra</s> food:

children.text: ahaṃ tan na vijānāmi kāṃ kāṃ yoniṃ gamiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: I do not know into which and which wombs he will go.

children.text: gṛdhro dvādaśajanmāni daśajanmāni sūkaraḥ
children.translated_text: For twelve births he is a vulture, for ten births a pig,

children.text: śvayonau saptajanmā syād ity evaṃ manur abravīt ||
children.translated_text: and for seven births he will be in a dog's womb; so <s>Manu</s> said.

children.text: dakṣiṇārtham tu yo vipraḥ śūdrasya juhuyāddhaviḥ
children.translated_text: But the brahmin who, for the sake of a fee, offers a <s>Śūdra</s>'s oblation:

children.text: brāhmaṇas tu bhavecchūdraḥ śūdras tu brāhmaṇo bhavet ||
children.translated_text: the brahmin becomes a <s>Śūdra</s>, and the <s>Śūdra</s> becomes a brahmin.

children.text: maunavrataṃ samāśritya āsīno na vaded dvijaḥ
children.translated_text: Having undertaken a vow of silence, a twice-born man sitting down should not speak;

children.text: bhuñjāno hi vaded yas tu tad annaṃ parivarjayet ||
children.translated_text: but if he speaks while eating, one should avoid that food.

children.text: ardhe bhukte tu yo vipras tasmin pātre jalaṃ pibet
children.translated_text: If a brahmin, when half the meal has been eaten, drinks water from that vessel,

children.text: hataṃ daivaṃ ca pitryaṃ ca ātmānaṃ copaghātayet ||
children.translated_text: he destroys what belongs to the gods and ancestors, and he harms himself.

children.text: bhuñjāneṣu tu vipreṣu yo 'gre pātraṃ vimuñcati
children.translated_text: When brahmins are eating, the man who first sets aside his dish

children.text: sa mūḍhaḥ sa ca pāpiṣṭho brahmaghnaḥ sa khalūcyate ||
children.translated_text: is a fool, and he is most sinful; he is indeed called a brahmin-slayer.

children.text: bhājaneṣu ca tiṣṭhatsu svastikurvanti ye dvijāḥ
children.translated_text: Those twice-born men who pronounce blessings while the dishes remain in place:

children.text: na devās tṛptim āyānti nirāśāḥ pitaras tathā ||
children.translated_text: the gods do not attain satisfaction, and the ancestors likewise are disappointed.

children.text: asnātvā naiva bhuñjītā ajaptvāgnim ahūya ca
children.translated_text: One should not eat without bathing, nor without reciting, nor without invoking the fire;

children.text: parṇapṛṣṭhe na bhuñjīta rātrau dīpaṃ vinā tathā ||
children.translated_text: one should not eat on the back of a leaf, nor at night without a lamp.

children.text: gṛhasthas tu dayāyukto dharmam evānucintayet
children.translated_text: But a householder, endowed with compassion, should think only of <s>dharma</s> (righteous order),

children.text: poṣyavargārthasiddhyarthaṃ nyāyavartī subuddhimān ||
children.translated_text: intelligent, acting justly for the sake of securing the welfare of those he must support.

children.text: nyāyopārjitavittena kartavyaṃ hy ātmarakṣaṇam
children.translated_text: Self-protection should be carried out with wealth acquired justly;

children.text: anyāyena tu yo jīvet sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: but one who lives by injustice is excluded from all rites.

children.text: agnicit kapilā satrī rājā bhikṣur mahodadhiḥ
children.translated_text: An establisher of sacred fires, a tawny cow, a sacrificer in a <s>satra</s>, a king, a mendicant, and the great ocean:

children.text: dṛṣṭamātrāḥ punanty ete tasmāt paśyet tu nityaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: these purify by the mere sight of them; therefore one should see them constantly.

children.text: araṇiṃ kṛṣṇamārjāraṃ candanaṃ sumaṇiṃ ghṛtam
children.translated_text: A fire-stick, a black cat, sandalwood, a fine jewel, ghee,

children.text: tilān kṛṣṇājinaṃ chāgaṃ gṛhe caitāni rakṣayet ||
children.translated_text: sesame seeds, a black antelope skin, and a goat: one should keep these in the house.

children.text: gavāṃ śataṃ saikavṛṣaṃ yatra tiṣṭhaty ayantritam
children.translated_text: Where a hundred cows together with one bull stay unrestrained,

children.text: tat kṣetraṃ daśagaṇitaṃ gocarmaparikīrtitam ||
children.translated_text: that field, multiplied by ten, is called a <s>gocarma</s>.

children.text: brahmahatyādibhir martyo manovākkāyakarmajaiḥ
children.translated_text: A mortal, with sins such as brahmin-slaying produced by mind, speech, or bodily action,

children.text: etad gocarmadānena mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: is released from all faults by the gift of this <s>gocarma</s>.

children.text: kuṭumbine daridrāya śrotriyāya viśeṣataḥ
children.translated_text: A gift that is given to a poor householder, especially to a learned <s>śrotriya</s>,

children.text: yad dānaṃ dīyate tasmai tad dānaṃ śubhakārakam ||
children.translated_text: that gift is productive of good.

children.text: vāpīkūpataḍāgādyair vājapeyaśatair mukhaiḥ
children.translated_text: By reservoirs, wells, ponds, and the like, by hundreds of <s>Vājapeya</s> sacrifices and principal rites,

children.text: gavāṃ koṭipradānena bhūmihartā na śudhyati ||
children.translated_text: or by the gift of ten million cows, a taker of land is not purified.

children.text: aṣṭādaśadinād arvāk snānam eva rajasvalā
children.translated_text: Before eighteen days a menstruating woman has only bathing as purification;

children.text: ata ūrdhvaṃ trirātraṃ syād uśanā munir abravīt ||
children.translated_text: after that there should be three nights, so the sage <s>Uśanas</s> said.

children.text: yugaṃ yugadvayaṃ caiva triyugaṃ ca caturyugam
children.translated_text: One yuga, two yugas, three yugas, and four yugas,

children.text: cāṇḍālasūtikodakyāpatitānām adhaḥ kramāt ||
children.translated_text: for a <s>Caṇḍāla</s>, a woman in childbirth impurity, a menstruating woman, and a fallen person respectively, in descending order.

children.text: tataḥ saṃnidhimātreṇa sacailaṃ snānam ācaret
children.translated_text: Then by mere proximity one should bathe with one's clothes on;

children.text: snātvāvalokayet sūryam ajñānāt spṛśate yadi ||
children.translated_text: after bathing one should look at the sun if one has touched unknowingly.

children.text: vidyamāneṣu hasteṣu brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ
children.translated_text: A brahmin, weak in knowledge, who, while hands are available,

children.text: toyaṃ pibati vaktreṇa śvayonau jāyate dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: drinks water with his mouth is certainly born in a dog's womb.

children.text: yas tu kruddhaḥ pumān brūyāj jāyāyās tu agamyatām
children.translated_text: If an angry man should say that his wife is unapproachable,

children.text: punar icchati ced enāṃ vipramadhye tu śrāvayet ||
children.translated_text: and later desires her again, he should have it announced among brahmins.

children.text: śrāntaḥ kruddhas tamo'ndho vā kṣutpipāsābhayārditaḥ
children.translated_text: If he is weary, angry, blinded by darkness, or afflicted by hunger, thirst, or fear,

children.text: dānaṃ puṇyam akṛtvā tu prāyaścittaṃ dinatrayam ||
children.translated_text: then, without having done a meritorious gift, the expiation is three days.

children.text: upaspṛśet triṣavaṇaṃ mahānadyupasaṃgame
children.translated_text: He should sip water at the three junctions of the day at the confluence of a great river;

children.text: cīrṇānte caiva gāṃ dadyād brāhmaṇān bhojayed daśa ||
children.translated_text: at the end of the observance he should give a cow and feed ten brahmins.

children.text: durācārasya viprasya niṣiddhācaraṇasya ca
children.translated_text: Having eaten the food of a badly conducted brahmin,

children.text: annaṃ bhuktvā dvijaḥ kuryād dinam ekam abhojanam ||
children.translated_text: or of one who performs forbidden acts, a twice-born man should fast for one day.

children.text: sadācārasya viprasya tathā vedāntavedinaḥ
children.translated_text: A man is freed from sin within a day and night after eating the food

children.text: bhuktvānnaṃ mucyate pāpād ahorātrāntarān naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: of a Brahmin who has good conduct and likewise knows the Vedānta.

children.text: ūrdhvocchiṣṭam adhocchiṣṭam antarikṣam ṛtau tathā
children.translated_text: For leavings above, leavings below, leavings in the intermediate space, and likewise in the menstrual period,

children.text: kṛcchratrayaṃ prakurvīta aśaucamaraṇe tathā ||
children.translated_text: and also in impurity caused by death, he should perform three <s>kṛcchras</s>.

children.text: kṛcchraṃ devy ayutaṃ caiva prāṇāyāmaśatadvayam
children.translated_text: A <s>kṛcchra</s>, ten thousand recitations of the goddess, and two hundred breath restraints,

children.text: puṇyatīrthe 'nārdraśiraḥ snānaṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyayā ||
children.translated_text: or bathing twelve times at a holy ford, with the head not wet.

children.text: dviyojane tīrthayātrā kṛcchram ekaṃ prakalpitam
children.translated_text: For a pilgrimage of two yojanas, one <s>kṛcchra</s> is prescribed.

children.text: gṛhasthaḥ kāmataḥ kuryād retasaḥ skhalanaṃ bhuvi ||
children.translated_text: If a householder intentionally causes his semen to fall on the ground,

children.text: sahasraṃ tu japed devyāḥ prāṇāyāmais tribhiḥ saha
children.translated_text: he should recite the goddess's mantra a thousand times, together with three breath restraints.

children.text: caturvidyopapannas tu vidhivad brahmaghātake ||
children.translated_text: For one furnished with the four Vedas, in the case of killing a Brahmin according to rule,

children.text: samudrasetugamanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet
children.translated_text: one should prescribe as expiation going to the ocean bridge.

children.text: setubandhapathe bhikṣāṃ cāturvarṇyāt samācaret ||
children.translated_text: On the road to the bridge, he should seek alms from the four varṇas.

children.text: varjayitvā vikarmasthāṃś chatropānadvivarjitaḥ
children.translated_text: Avoiding those engaged in forbidden acts, and without umbrella or shoes,

children.text: ahaṃ duṣkṛtakarmā vai mahāpātakakārakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he should say, “I am indeed a doer of evil deeds, a committer of a great sin.

children.text: gṛhadvāreṣu tiṣṭhāmi bhikṣārthī brahmaghātakaḥ
children.translated_text: I stand at the doors of houses, seeking alms, a killer of a Brahmin.”

children.text: gokuleṣu vasec caiva grāmeṣu nagareṣu vā ||
children.translated_text: He should dwell in cow-stations, or in villages and towns,

children.text: tapovaneṣu tīrtheṣu nadīprasravaṇeṣu vā
children.translated_text: in ascetic groves, at sacred fords, or by rivers and springs.

children.text: eteṣu khyāpayann enaḥ puṇyaṃ gatvā tu sāgaram ||
children.translated_text: Proclaiming his sin in these places, and then going in purity to the ocean,

children.text: daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ śatayojanam āyatam
children.translated_text: ten yojanas broad and a hundred yojanas long,

children.text: rāmacandrasamādiṣṭanalasaṃcayasaṃcitam ||
children.translated_text: he should see the bridge of the ocean, heaped up by the mass of stones ordered by <s>Rāmacandra</s> and <s>Nala</s>;

children.text: setuṃ dṛṣṭvā samudrasya brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
children.translated_text: having seen the bridge of the ocean, he drives away the sin of killing a Brahmin.

children.text: setuṃ dṛṣṭvā viśuddhātmā tvavagāheta sāgaram ||
children.translated_text: Having seen the bridge, purified in self, he should plunge into the ocean.

children.text: yajeta vāśvamedhena rājā tu pṛthivīpatiḥ
children.translated_text: Or the king, lord of the earth, should sacrifice with a horse sacrifice.

children.text: punaḥ pratyāgate veśma vāsārtham upasarpati ||
children.translated_text: When he has returned again to his house and approaches it for residence,

children.text: saputraḥ saha bhṛtyaiś ca kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam
children.translated_text: together with his sons and with his servants he should make a feeding of Brahmins.

children.text: gāś caivaikaśataṃ dadyāccaturvidhyeṣu dakṣiṇām ||
children.translated_text: And he should give one hundred and one cows as a fee to those learned in the four Vedas.

children.text: brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādena brahmahā tu vimucyate
children.translated_text: Through the favor of the Brahmins, the killer of a Brahmin is freed.

children.text: savanasthāṃ striyaṃ hatvā brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret ||
children.translated_text: Having killed a pregnant woman, one should observe the vow for killing a Brahmin.

children.text: madyapaś ca dvijaḥ kuryān nadīṃ gatvā samudragām
children.translated_text: And a twice-born drinker of liquor should go to a river that reaches the ocean;

children.text: cāndrāyaṇe tataś cīrṇe kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
children.translated_text: then, after performing a <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>, he should make a feeding of Brahmins.

children.text: anaḍutsahitāṃ gāṃ ca dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām
children.translated_text: He should give as a fee among Brahmins a cow accompanied by a bull.

children.text: surāpānaṃ sakṛt kṛtvā agnivarṇaṃ surāṃ pibet ||
children.translated_text: Having drunk liquor once, he should drink liquor heated to the color of fire.

children.text: sa pāvayed athātmānam ihaloke paratra ca
children.translated_text: Then he purifies himself both in this world and in the next.

children.text: apahṛtya suvarṇaṃ tu brāhmaṇasya tataḥ svayam ||
children.translated_text: But after stealing the gold of a Brahmin, he himself

children.text: gacchen musalam ādāya rājābhyāśaṃ vadhāya tu
children.translated_text: should go, taking a club, into the presence of the king for execution.

children.text: tataḥ śuddhim avāpnoti rājñāsau mukta eva ca ||
children.translated_text: Then he obtains purification, once released by the king.

children.text: kāmatas tu kṛtaṃ yat syān nānyathā vadham arhati
children.translated_text: If the act was done intentionally, then in no other way does he deserve release from death.

children.text: āsanācchayanād yānāt saṃbhāṣāt sahabhojanāt ||
children.translated_text: From sitting, lying, riding, conversation, and eating together,

children.text: saṃkrāmanti hi pāpāni tailabindur ivāmbhasi
children.translated_text: sins pass over, like a drop of oil in water.

children.text: cāndrāyaṇaṃ yāvakaṃ tu tulāpuruṣa eva ca ||
children.translated_text: The <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s>, the barley diet, and the <s>tulāpuruṣa</s>,

children.text: gavāṃ caivānugamanaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
children.translated_text: as well as following cows, destroy every sin.

children.text: etat pārāśaraṃ śāstraṃ ślokānāṃ śatapañcakaṃ
children.translated_text: This is the teaching of <s>Parāśara</s>, a collection of the <s>dharmaśāstra</s>,

children.text: dvinavatyā samāyuktaṃ dharmaśāstrasya saṃgrahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: amounting to five hundred verses together with ninety-two.

children.text: yathādhyayanakarmāṇi dharmaśāstram idaṃ tathā
children.translated_text: Just as one's study and rites are to be performed, so too this <s>dharmaśāstra</s>

children.text: adhyetavyaṃ prayatnena niyataṃ svargagāminā ||
children.translated_text: should be studied carefully and regularly by one who wishes to go to heaven.
